Asset swap spread levels initially proved very resilient to

geopolitical instability and related economic changes this year.
Despite some volatility in March, following the outbreak of the US-
Israel conﬂict with Iran, spread levels recovered quickly and reached
levels close to their historic low. However, a broader escalation of
the conﬂict across the Middle East, coupled with the absence of a
clear path to resolution, could put further pressure on spreads.
In addition, budget and political concerns in France and OAT-Bund

volatility, as well as broader European ﬁscal concerns, have recently
led to spreads widening again. The combination of French political
uncertainty and the Middle East conﬂict could trigger some periods
of volatility in the market in 2027. However, we believe these
uncertainties will not be a strong negative for bank bond supply.
Depending on the timing, though, periodic widening may make
ﬁnancial institutions less keen to pre-fund redemptions coming up

in 2028.

Our estimate includes €185bn in covered bonds, comprising
€180bn in benchmark-sized issuances, including ﬂoating rate
notes, and €5bn in sub-benchmark bonds. This is a €5bn drop
versus our 2026 forecast. It reﬂects the pre-ﬁnancing already made
by issuers this year in preparation for the historically high
redemptions.
Furthermore, next year’s mortgage lending forecasts point to
stagnation, somewhat limiting any further increase in covered

bond issuance. Besides, with the securitisation package entering its
ﬁnalisation stage, issuers with high funding needs may shift some
secured issuance towards securitisation for diversiﬁcation
purposes. Increasing demand for covered bonds from overseas
investors driven by regulatory developments may also result in
more currency diversiﬁcation, away from EUR-denominated
issuance.
We forecast senior unsecured supply to reach €210bn next year.
This is split between €70bn in senior preferred bonds and €140bn in

senior bail-in instruments. It represents a €10bn YoY decline in

### Page 5

senior preferred supply, reﬂecting both the drop in the segment’s
redemptions from 2027 onwards and the potential impact of the
Crisis Management and Deposit Insurance (CMDI) framework. As the
CMDI reforms are expected to enter into force in 2028, they could
reduce the attractiveness of senior preferred bonds versus senior
bail-in instruments in some EU countries, as senior preferred
exposures will rank lower than, and no longer pari passu to,
uncovered deposits in the creditor hierarchy. The funding cost

advantage of senior preferred unsecured issuance could decline. At
the same time, issuing senior non-preferred bonds could serve the
purpose of increasing the bail-inable layer protecting preferred
senior bonds and their current ratings. This could shift some
issuers’ focus towards the senior non-preferred bucket instead of
the senior preferred segment.
Our forecast for senior non-preferred supply remains stable
compared to our 2026 estimate. While redemptions will increase by

€6bn in 2027 and further in 2028 to reach €102bn, we believe the
impact of higher reﬁnancing needs on non-preferred senior supply
will be partially oﬀset by the lack of balance sheet growth against
the backdrop of higher interest rates. Furthermore, the
outperformance of US dollar debt versus EUR-denominated debt
could see issuers turn more often towards the USD market,
potentially negatively aﬀecting EUR senior bail-in supply.
Lastly, we expect Tier 2 supply to reach €35bn and AT1 supply to

reach €20bn in 2027. This is a €5bn increase YoY in both AT1 and
Tier 2 compared to our 2026 forecast, mainly driven by higher
redemption levels. With AT1 redemptions in 2027 increasing by
€3bn YoY to €14bn, net supply is likely to be marginally higher next
year. In Tier 2, redemptions increase by €4bn to €31bn, essentially
meaning that net supply will only be marginally higher.
As the chart below highlights, net supply in AT1 has been
signiﬁcant in recent years but has slowed this year as the focus has

shifted towards reﬁnancing. As such, while we expect more AT1
supply next year compared to 2026, the levels are relatively in line
with the longer-term trend.

The main driver of supply will also be reﬁnancing for subordinated
capital. We expect a further marginal decline in CET1 buﬀers,
although most banks are already operating at target AT1 and Tier 2
ratios. Still, there are some issuers with substantial gaps in either
AT1 or Tier 2 ratios, which they may look to improve, leading to a

slight increase in supply.
Signiﬁcant Risk Transfer (SRT) issuance has also increased in recent
years and will continue to grow as a tool for banks in terms of
balance sheet and capital management, while it is also growing as
an investable asset class. Although SRTs provide capital and RWA
relief, they do not replace the gone-concern and loss-absorption
capacity of AT1 and Tier 2 instruments. As such, they play a more
complementary role in capital management, and we do not expect

it to have a major impact on bank capital issuance in 2027.
Bank M&A could also be a wildcard for 2027 issuance. With several
large M&A transactions potentially taking place, this may lead to
some capital optimisation and less incremental supply needs;
conversely, goodwill eﬀects, potential regulatory increases in buﬀer
requirements or RWA inﬂation may lead to a slight increase in the
need for capital. However, on the whole, we would expect M&A to

have a slight dampening eﬀect on supply.

Lợi nhuận sau thuế công ty mẹ tăng 
trưởng khả quan trong 2Q26 14% 
YoY, với động lực chính đến từ mảng 
dịch vụ CNTT nước ngoài

Mảng CNTT nước ngoài: Lĩnh vực dịch 
vụ IT phân cực mạnh mẽ do tác nhân 
AI (AI Agentic) s ẽ củng c ố xu hư ớng 
đầu tư vào AI

FPT ở vị thế thuận lợi cho phép 
doanh nghiệp đa dạng hóa công cụ 
AI và tối ưu chi phí vận hành

Khuyến ngh ị MUA với giá m ục tiêu 
86,000 VND/cổ phiếu 
 Do không còn h ạch toán FPT Telecom (FOX) là công ty con, d oanh thu 2Q2026 của 
FPT giảm mạnh còn 13,810 tỷ VND (-17% YoY). Lợi nhuận sau thuế công ty mẹ không 
bị ảnh hưởng bởi thay đổi hạch toán đạt 2,568 tỷ VND (14% YoY). Mảng dịch vụ CNTT 
tại thị trường nước ngoài tiếp tục là đ ộng lực tăng trư ởng chính, đạt doanh thu và 
LNTT lần lượt là 9,868/1,538 tỷ VND (16.3% /19.3% YoY).

Sự chuyển dịch chi tiêu từ dịch vụ IT truyền thống sang chuyển đổi số và tích hợp AI 
được kỳ vọng sẽ diễn ra ngày m ột mạnh mẽ khi: i) Sự phát triển của năng l ực tính 
toán giúp kéo giảm chi phí token (đơn v ị năng lực tính toán của AI) và thúc đ ẩy nhu 
cầu sử dụng AI của doanh nghiệp; ii) Các mô hình AI mã nguồn mở gia tăng lựa chọn 
cho người dùng sẽ thúc đẩy chi tiêu

Đối với các doanh nghiệp ứng dụng sâu các mô hình AI phục vụ hoạt động kinh doanh 
như FPT , chúng tôi nhận thấy xu hướng tối ưu chi phí tốt hơn nhờ khả năng sử dụng 
các mô hình AI đ ến từ đa dạng nhà cung c ấp; với chi phí trên hi ệu năng tính toán 
được cải thi ện. Trong k ịch b ản cơ s ở, chúng tôi d ự báo biên l ợi nhuận trước thu ế 
mảng CNTT nước ngoài sẽ ổn định ở mức 15.4% nhờ duy trì chi ến lược quản trị chi 
phí hiệu quả qua đó giúp LNTT 2026/2027 đạt 6,198/7,087 tỷ VND (13.3%/14.3% YoY).

Dựa trên định giá FCFF và P/E, triển vọng kinh doanh cũng như xem xét các rủi ro có 
thể phát sinh, chúng tôi khuyến nghị MUA đối với cổ phiếu FPT . Giá mục tiêu là 86,000 
VND/cổ phiếu.

Các mảng kinh doanh duy trì ổn định 
giúp lợi nhuận sau thuế công ty mẹ 
tăng trưởng nhẹ

Sản lượng điện của REE tăng trưởng 
nhẹ nhờ mức tăng của mảng điện gió 
sau khi dự án Duyên Hải V1-4 vận 
hành

Mảng M&E ghi nhận giá trị ký mới cao 
trong 1H.2026, t ạo kỳ vọng hồi phục 
mạnh mẽ doanh thu

Mảng cho thuê văn phòng đứng trước 
cơ hội lớn đóng góp vào tăng trư ởng 
nhờ các điều kiện thuận lợi

Khuyến nghị MUA với giá mục tiêu 
58,100 VNĐ/cổ phiếu

Doanh thu Quý 2/2026 giảm nhẹ, đạt 2,432 tỷ VND (-3% YoY/-2% QoQ), trong khi l ợi 
nhuận sau thuế công ty mẹ đạt 632 tỷ VND (+1% YoY/-11.5% QoQ), do doanh thu của 
mảng bất động sản suy giảm. Qua đó, REE hoàn thành lần lượt 40%/47.8% kế hoạch 
doanh thu và LNST công ty mẹ 2026.

Trong Q2.2026, tổng sản lượng phát đi ện của REE tăng nh ẹ, đạt 2.8 tỷ kWh (+2.3% 
YoY) với đóng góp tăng trưởng rõ nét đến từ mảng điện gió khi dự án Duyên Hải V1-4 
bắt đầu vận hành; tuy nhiên  sản lượng thủy điện suy gi ảm do tác đ ộng tiêu c ực từ 
pha thời tiết El Nino, đạt 1.1 tỷ kWh.

Với năng lực chuyên môn được nâng cao, mảng M&E ghi nhận những dấu hiệu phục 
hồi tích cực trong giá trị hợp đồng ký mới trong 1H.2026, 5,865 tỷ VND (cao hơn 53.9% 
so với giá trị ký mới cả năm 2025). KBSV dự phóng doanh thu c ủa mảng M&E sẽ đạt 
4,499/5,190 tỷ VND (+28%/15% YoY) trong 2026/2027.

Hội tụ bởi 3 yếu tố: i) Định hướng phát triển kinh tế Hồ Chí Minh trở thành trung tâm 
tài chính quốc tế; ii) Hạ tầng giao thông ngày một được hoàn thiện và iii) Chi phí thuê 
cạnh tranh so với chất lượng dịch vụ của E. Town 6, KBSV dự phóng doanh thu mảng 
cho thuê văn phòng trong 2026/2027 tăng trưởng +14%/6.2% YoY.

Dựa trên đ ịnh giá SOTP , triển vọng kinh doanh cũng như xem xét các r ủi ro có th ể 
phát sinh, chúng tôi khuy ến nghị MUA đối với cổ phiếu REE. Giá m ục tiêu là 58,100 
VND/cổ phiếu, cao hơn 28.3% so với mức giá đóng cửa tại ngày 15/09/2026.

Doanh thu 2Q.26 bứt phá nhờ khoản 
thu nhập bất thường của nhiệt điện 
Cà Mau và Vũng Áng

Nhiệt đi ện than duy trì công su ất ở 
mức cao nh ờ nguồn cung nhiên li ệu 
ổn định trong 2H26

Điện khí Đông Nam Bộ (NT1&2 và 
NT3&4) có triển vọng hoạt động 
thuận lợi

Khuyến nghị MUA với giá mục tiêu 
18,100 VND/cổ phiếu 
 Trong Quý 2/2026, POW ghi nhận Doanh thu và LNST cổ đông công ty mẹ đạt lần lượt 
20,308 tỷ VND (116.1% YoY) và 3,519 tỷ VND (484.6% YoY) chủ yếu nhờ các khoản thu 
nhập từ chênh lệch tiền khí của nhiệt điện Cà Mau và tỷ giá của nhiệt điện Vũng Áng. 
Với kết qu ả trên, POW hoàn thành l ần lư ợt 65%/420% kế hoạch doanh thu và l ợi 
nhuận sau thuế công ty mẹ.

Chúng tôi cho r ằng nhà máy nhi ệt than Vũng Áng trong 2026 s ẽ được duy trì công 
suất huy động ở mức cao nhờ: i) Xác suất diễn ra El Nino tăng cao và dự kiến kéo dài 
đến đầu 2027, ii) Nguồn cung than trong nước được bảo đảm từ các đối tác (TKV, TCT 
Đông B ắc) và d ự trữ than d ồi dào c ủa doanh nghi ệp ghi nh ận ở mức cao trong 
Q2/2026.

Dự án đường dây 500kV Mạch 3 đi vào vận hành giúp giảm áp lực cạnh tranh của các 
nhà máy điện tại khu vực phía Nam, qua đó kỳ vọng doanh thu của NT1&2 trong năm 
2026 đạt 11,104 tỷ VND (5.3% YoY). Đối với dự án điện NT3&4, khoản thu nhập chênh 
lệch sản lượng theo giá công suất do sản lượng điện thực tế thấp hơn so với tỷ lệ Qc 
65% của nhà máy được duy trì sang 2H26 và 2027 sẽ giúp cho dự án ghi nhận doanh 
thu lần lượt 17,848/17,621 tỷ VND doanh thu trong 2026/2027.

Dựa trên định giá SOTP và EV/EBITDA, tri ển vọng kinh doanh cũng như xem xét các 
rủi ro có th ể phát sinh, chúng tôi khuy ến nghị MUA đối với cổ phiếu POW. Giá m ục 
tiêu là 18,100 VND/cổ phiếu.

2Q2026, AST ghi nh ận doanh thu và LNST đ ạt 479/92 t ỷ VND (+22%/19% yoy), với 
động lực chủ yếu đến từ (1) đóng góp từ 19 điểm kinh doanh mở mới tại T3 Tân Sơn 
Nhất và (2) tăng trưởng tích cực của các mảng hàng miễn thuế, nhà hàng - fastfood 
và phòng ch ờ thương gia. Lũy k ế 6T2026, doanh thu và LNST đ ạt 1,035/221 t ỷ VND 
(+33%/46% yoy), lần lượt hoàn thành 48%/49% kế hoạch năm.

Chúng tôi dự phóng lượng khách quốc tế/nội địa tại các thị trường AST khai thác tăng 
bình quân 11%/5% mỗi năm đến 2030. Lưu lượng và tỷ trọng khách quốc tế gia tăng 
được kỳ vọng thúc đẩy số giao dịch và doanh thu bình quân trên mỗi khách, đặc biệt 
tại mảng miễn thuế, bán lẻ và phòng chờ.

Chúng tôi dự phóng số điểm kinh doanh AST tăng từ 145 điểm cuối năm 2026 lên 182 
điểm năm 2030. Sau đóng góp t ừ 19 điểm tại T3 Tân Sơn Nh ất và 6 điểm mới tại T2 
Nội Bài từ 2025 - 2026, các dự án Long Thành, Phú Qu ốc và Gia Bình ti ếp tục mở ra 
dư địa mở rộng mạng lưới trong trung và dài hạn cho doanh nghiệp.

Việc mở rộng các hoạt động mang lại lợi nhuận cao, bao gồm hàng miễn thuế, phòng 
chờ thương gia và tối ưu hoạt động tại các điểm kinh doanh đ ược kỳ vọng tác động 
tích c ực lên biên l ợi nhu ận của AST . Chúng tôi dự phóng biên l ợi nhu ận g ộp đ ạt 
64.7%/65.5% trong năm 2026/2027, hỗ trợ LNST công ty mẹ tăng lần lượt 48%/17% 
yoy.

Chúng tôi khuy ến nghị MUA đối với AST , giá mục tiêu 76 ,500 VND/cổ phiếu, tương 
đương tiềm năng tăng giá 20% so với giá đóng cửa ngày 21/09/2026.

Doanh thu 2Q2026 đạt 1,222 tỷ (-8% YoY/18.1% QoQ) và LNST công ty mẹ đạt 325 tỷ 
VND (7% YoY/55% QoQ), ghi nhận tăng trưởng của tất cả các mảng. Mảng cung cấp 
nước tăng trưởng ổn định, tiếp tục là trụ cột chính của BWE, đóng góp doanh thu 785 
tỷ VND (+12% YoY/12% QoQ) nhờ nhà máy nước Long An v ận hành từ Q3/2025 giúp 
sản lượng nước tăng 28% YoY.

Cường độ và thời gian kéo dài c ủa các đ ợt nắng nóng trong 2026/2027 là cơ s ở để 
chúng tôi đi ều chỉnh tăng tăng trư ởng tiêu th ụ nước của nhóm khách hàng dân cư 
tại Bình Dương và Bình Phư ớc trong năm 2026 - 2027 lên mức 7.5/6.5% YoY. Trái lại, 
triển vọng tăng trưởng tiêu thụ nước nhóm sản xuất ảm đạm do tình hình thuế quan 
có diễn biến bất lợi trong ngắn hạn cho các ngành xu ất khẩu truyền thống của Việt 
Nam.

UBND TP .HCM công bố đơn giá thu gom, vận chuyển và xử lý rác thải mới, tăng mạnh 
từ 50-150% nhằm phản ánh đầy đủ và chính xác hơn các chi phí phát sinh trong thực 
tế. Chúng tôi cho rằng điều này sẽ tác động tích cực với BWE khi các dự án của doanh 
nghiệp ở mảng này s ẽ vận hành hi ệu quả hơn. Dự báo doanh thu và l ợi nhuận gộp 
của mảng xử lý rác thải lần lượt đạt 1,069/1,234 và 165.7/180.7 tỷ VND lần lượt trong 
2026/2027, tương ứng mức tăng 34%/15% và 27%/9% YoY.

Kết hợp 2 phương pháp định giá FCFF và EV/EBITDA, KBSV khuyến nghị MUA với BWE,

Ngưỡng kỹ thuật

VNINDEX điều chỉnh trở lại trong tuần qua sau khi gặp thử thách tại vùng cản quanh 1850, 
hình thành cây nến tuần giảm điểm nhưng với phần bóng dưới khá dài cho thấy sự tham 
gia tích cực của lực cầu bắt đáy tại vùng hỗ trợ gần. Trên khung ngày, nhịp giảm mạnh giữa 
tuần đã khiến chỉ số đánh mất đáy ngắn hạn tuần trước và chớm cắt xuống dưới SMA200, 
trong khi phiên hồi phục cuối tuần chưa cho thấy sự cải thiện rõ rệt của lực cầu. Mặc dù 
diễn biến này cho thấy áp lực điều chỉnh vẫn có thể còn tiếp diễn, tuy nhiên khi xu hướng 
tăng ngắn hạn chưa bị phá vỡ, VNINDEX được kỳ vọng sẽ nhận được lực đỡ tại vùng hỗ trợ 
gần quanh 1750, tương ứng vùng hợp lưu quanh SMA50, và có cơ hội hồi phục trở lại.

- Lợi nhuận kỳ vọng được tính theo giá khuyến nghị mua.

Weekly Economics
U.S. Week Ahead
Existing Home Sales • Thursday
Housing market conditions remain highly unfavorable. Mortgage
rates are the primary headwind, and they have climbed even higher
alongside the rise in longer-term yields. At the same time, low
supply is preventing a broad correction in home prices, leaving
prospective buyers squeezed on two fronts.
We expect that existing home sales slid 3.4% in August to an
annualized rate of 3.92 million. Behind this forecast is ongoing

weakness in mortgage applications and a recent bounce in
mortgage rates, which rose from 6.43% at the beginning of July to
6.66% by month-end.
We do not expect affordability conditions to meaningfully improve
in the near term. Supply is likely to remain constrained while high
mortgage rates discourage mobility. And mortgage rates are apt
to remain elevated amid firm economic growth expectations and
heavy government and corporate debt issuance.

### Page 3

Economics Week Ahead Economics
CPI • Friday
Headline inflation looks to have picked up last month. We estimate
the CPI rose 0.40% in August, with gasoline prices increasing a little
over 4% as renewed tensions in the Middle East pushed oil higher.
Grocery prices also likely rebounded after modestly declining in July.
Outside of food and energy, price pressures appear little changed.
We expect the core CPI to rise 0.23%, essentially matching July's

pace. Core goods inflation should remain firm, led by another solid
increase in used vehicle prices as consumer prices continue to
catch up to the trend indicated at wholesale auctions. Meantime,
household furnishings and other tariff-sensitive categories appear
to be stabilizing after declining earlier this year.
Core services inflation should be little changed with another 0.2%
monthly increase. But underneath the surface, we expect a modest
pickup in travel (led by lodging away from home) to offset slightly

cooler medical care and housing cost growth.
All told, we expect the report to show that while headline inflation
remains influenced by the ebbs and flows of the conflict in the
Middle East, core inflation remains contained. Should our forecast
prove correct, core CPI will ease to 2.4% year-over-year, in line with
its 6-month annualized rate but above the more recent 3-month
annualized pace of 1.7%.

Weekly Economics
G10 Week Ahead
European Central Bank Monetary Policy Meeting •
Thursday
We expect the European Central Bank (ECB) to raise the Deposit
Rate by 25 bps to 2.50% next week. August headline inflation
remained elevated at 3.3% year-over-year, though softer core
and services inflation suggest underlying pressures continue to
moderate. Still, the more hawkish tone of the July minutes and
renewed rise in energy prices should keep policymakers cautious.

The recent escalation in the Middle East has pushed fuel prices
at the pump close to their 2022 peaks, while natural gas storage
remains below historical levels, leaving the Eurozone vulnerable
to further energy price increases. The ECB is unlikely to respond
aggressively if the shock remains confined to energy given the
downside risks to growth. However, a broader rise in food inflation
linked to El Niño would be more concerning, as highly visible prices

could lift inflation expectations and generate second-round effects.
For now, resilient Q3 activity, elevated headline inflation and
contained wage growth support one final hike. The ECB will likely
retain and emphasize its scenario-based outlook in the updated
staff projections given continued uncertainty around the conflict
and energy prices. The policy path beyond September will depend
on whether energy and food pressures persist and begin to spread,

which could leave room for further tightening.

Mexico CPI • Wednesday
We expect Mexico’s August inflation rate to edge higher, with
headline CPI rising to 3.34% year-over-year (0.27% month-over-
month) from 3.26% year-over-year in early August. Part of the
pickup likely reflects less favorable base effects and a smaller
disinflationary contribution from food prices. While agricultural
prices continued to help restrain inflation in mid-August, the drag

was notably less pronounced than in July. Core inflation should
remain elevated at 3.98% year-over-year (0.25% month-over-
month).
While inflation remains within Banxico’s midpoint 3% target,
persistent core and services inflation suggest convergence toward
the midpoint of the target could prove gradual. For now, we
continue to expect Banxico to keep rates on hold, with the policy
rate remaining at 6.50% through the rest of 2026 and into early
2027 as policymakers await clearer evidence that underlying

inflation pressures are easing sustainably. While rate cuts remain
a possibility in 2027, the current inflation backdrop argues for
patience in the near term.

Brazil CPI • Friday
We expect Brazil’s August inflation rate to slow to 4.20% year-over-
year, helped by lower electricity, food and fuel prices. The main
driver should be a temporary reduction in residential electricity bills
stemming from a one-off credit, while recent data already point to
a notable easing in price pressures. Mid-August CPI came in weaker
than expected, with inflation falling to 4.24% year-over-year amid
declines in electricity, food, fuel and airfare prices. Beyond these

temporary factors, restrictive monetary policy continues to weigh
on economic activity, as evidenced by the recent slowdown in Q2
GDP growth. However, underlying inflation risks remain. A still-
tight labor market and government measures aimed at supporting
consumption could keep services inflation sticky, making progress
toward the 3.0% inflation target more gradual.
Overall, the inflation outlook remains consistent with additional
policy easing. We expect COPOM to deliver a 25 bps rate cut in

September, bringing the Selic Rate to 13.75%. Beyond September,
policymakers are likely to proceed cautiously as they assess
incoming inflation data and the impact of the election cycle on
inflation expectations. Our base case remains for a pause after
September, with additional easing more likely in 2027.

Cost shock hit proﬁtability, but for some

Jet fuel is often the largest or second-largest cost item for airlines.
In 2025, it accounted for 27% of total operational costs on average.
This share could move towards 35% in 2026 as a result of
persistently high jet fuel prices and elevated crack spreads, caused
by the loss of Middle Eastern supplies and tight global availability.
Further geopolitical developments remain highly uncertain. Even if
the Middle East conﬂict is resolved and oil prices retreat, tight

reﬁnery capacity and depleted inventories are likely to keep middle-
distillate prices, including jet fuel, elevated well into 2027.

Fuel hedging provides less cushioning in
2027; fares must respond
Airlines employ very diﬀerent strategies to protect themselves
against fuel price shocks, using derivatives based on crude oil or jet
fuel. European airlines generally hedged 40-90% of their jet fuel
consumption, cushioning the initial impact of the price shock.
However, the Middle East conﬂict has lasted too long to avoid a

signiﬁcant impact. Existing hedges gradually roll oﬀ, increasing
exposure to prevailing market prices. Ryanair, which remains (80%)
hedged until the second quarter of 2027, has already warned of
signiﬁcantly higher fares.
Outside, the picture is mixed, but hedge ratios are generally lower,
and airlines in the US and China, for instance, don’t hedge at all.
This means that two airlines operating similar routes can face very
diﬀerent fuel bills.
Airline tickets in the US responded much

faster to the cost shock than in Europe

The fuel price shock will increasingly feed through into higher fares.
US airlines’ practice of retaining relatively high exposure to fuel price
volatility resulted in an almost immediate pass-through, with ticket
prices rising solidly in the months after jet fuel prices started to rise.

It is also easier to raise prices when domestic competitors face a
similar cost shock.
The situation is diﬀerent in Europe, where hedging provided more
initial protection. This also means fares may still need to rise
signiﬁcantly if fuel prices fail to fall. Coverage gradually expires as
2027 progresses, leaving airlines increasingly exposed to higher
spot prices.

More factors are driving up costs,
particularly in Europe
Jet fuel is the clear outlier this year, but wage and maintenance
costs are also rising faster than the average price level. Borrowing
costs and aircraft leasing rates remain another factor, although the
impact depends on individual airlines’ strategies and ﬁnancial
structures.
European airlines also face rising costs from the European Union
Emissions Trading System (ETS) for ﬂights within the European

Economic Area. In addition, fuel suppliers are required to blend
sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) under ReFuelEU Aviation, starting at
2% and rising to 6% by 2030*. SAF still trades at a signiﬁcant
premium. This puts a price on emissions, and in combination, this
adds some $300 per tonne of jet fuel in 2026 (BNEF, ING Research).
Meanwhile, France and the Netherlands have either raised or plan
to raise ticket taxes, particularly on long-haul ﬂying, while Germany

has scaled its levy back and Sweden has abolished it.
High fuel prices put more pressure on low-

Low-cost carriers are particularly exposed because fuel accounts
for a larger share of their cost base, and proﬁt bases are more
vulnerable. High hedge ratios initially cushion volatility, but these
hedges gradually roll oﬀ. The more challenging environment is
already visible in the performance of several European low-cost
carriers and will remain an important theme in 2027 if fuel prices
stay elevated.
Premium carriers have more room to manoeuvre. Demand for

premium seats (business, premium economy) is less price-
sensitive, providing airlines with greater scope to pass on higher
costs. Both United Airlines and Delta Airlines reported little impact
after price increases of 15-20% in the second to third quarters.
Passengers are booking later, but airlines continue to indicate a
strong propensity to ﬂy, especially in premium and premium-
economy classes. A minority also accounts for a large share of
ﬂights. In the Netherlands, for example, 25% of people account for

75% of journeys. These frequent travellers tend to be less price-
sensitive.
There has therefore been some demand destruction wiping out part
of the underlying growth. So far, though, the propensity to travel
has remained resilient.
Aviation remains proﬁtable, but margins hit
a post-pandemic low
The fuel shock has signiﬁcantly aﬀected margins. On average,
proﬁts in the global industry are expected to drop meaningfully
below 5%. Airlines including Ryanair, Southwest Airlines and AirAsia

have scaled back capacity on unproﬁtable routes as elevated fuel
prices persisted longer than expected.
According to global aviation consultancy Cirium, around 1% of
global air travel capacity will be removed heading into the Northern
Hemisphere winter of 2026-27. In less mature markets, maintaining
volumes while passing on the higher fuel bill is more diﬃcult.
Airlines may also prioritise less fuel-eﬃcient, older-generation
aircraft over capacity growth.

Dynamic and algorithm-based pricing is becoming increasingly
common. This helps airlines optimise already historically high load
factors (84% in 2026 so far) but can also contribute to greater fare
volatility, especially as passengers book later amid uncertainty.
If fuel prices ease in 2027, fares could drop back. Yet relatively

Air cargo continues to perform well as a fast transport option in an
increasingly volatile and less predictable world. Volume growth
remained almost 5% year-to-date, while freight rates remained
attractive for carriers.
While e-commerce drove much of the growth in recent years,

digitalisation and large-scale AI investment increasingly support
shipments of high-value technology products. Strong cargo
performance helped cushion pressure on airline results in 2026.
European carriers also beneﬁted from reduced available freight
capacity from Middle Eastern competitors.
Freighter capacity received a boost during the pandemic through
passenger-to-freighter conversions, but that boost has largely run
its course. New-generation A350 and Boeing 777 freighters should

add capacity in the coming years.
Aircargo volume resilient in disruptive
geopolitical environment

Future demand 2027 and onwards
Aviation’s centre of gravity is increasingly
shifting eastwards
The centre of gravity of global aviation is increasingly shifting
eastwards. Trips per capita are expected to see strong increases
over the next two decades, particularly in Asia. This matters even
more because these markets are far more populous.
Until recently, around 90% of the world’s population did not ﬂy in a
given year, but this is gradually changing. As a result, ﬂeet growth is

expected to be strongest in Asia, with its share of the global aircraft
ﬂeet increasing from around 33% to approximately 45%.
People still expected to ﬂy more, especially
in India

India is becoming a powerhouse for future
airline growth
Air travel is strongly correlated with GDP and household income. As
Asia’s middle class expands, the potential customer base for air
travel swells. For future aviation demand, this income eﬀect is even
more important than population growth alone.
Younger generations also appear keen to travel, adding to the
potential in countries such as India and Indonesia. Increasingly

internationally dispersed families provide another structural source
of demand.
India stands out here. Strong economic growth, rising household
incomes and a huge population oﬀer strong potential. Airlines are
positioning themselves accordingly, illustrated by historically large
aircraft orders from IndiGo and Air India. India’s aircraft ﬂeet is
expected to grow by around 8% annually on average over the next
two decades.
China and India are the growth engines of

### Page 14

Source: S&P Global, Airbus, ING Research
Supply-side developments
Aircraft scarcity keeps capacity tight and
lease rates elevated
Supply constraints have been curbing aviation growth since the
post-pandemic recovery and remain a major factor. The share of
stored aircraft dropped below 10% by the end of 2025, its lowest
level since 2019. Even several A380s (the largest aircraft) have
returned to service.
More than half of the global commercial aircraft ﬂeet is leased.

Tight capacity is consequently reﬂected in relatively high used-
aircraft values and lease rates.
Airbus and Boeing had a combined record backlog of around
15,000 aircraft by mid-2026. Production and deliveries continue to
lag order intake after seven consecutive years of subdued deliveries
from 2019 onwards. Demand for new-generation aircraft remains
strong, as illustrated by major recent orders from Avolon and
Turkish Airlines.
Production could ﬁnally return to pre-pandemic levels in 2027.

Chinese manufacturer COMAC, meanwhile, is making progress in
China in Asia, but Western certiﬁcation remains distant.

New airplane deliveries continue on a

Source: Company reports *Company forecast
Why aircraft supply remains constrained
Production has still not caught up with pre-pandemic levels
and is unlikely to do so in the next ﬁve years. Aircraft
manufacturing is recovering, but delays and large backlogs
push delivery dates into the 2030s. Airlines are therefore forced

to keep older aircraft ﬂying for longer.
Suppliers are still struggling to ramp up. Six years after the
sharp pandemic downturn, aviation supply chains have still
not fully normalised. Stringent safety and certiﬁcation
requirements mean manufacturers rely on a limited number of
specialised suppliers. Engines and sophisticated cabin
components still have long lead times, while skilled workers
remain scarce.
Engine issues continue to aﬀect available capacity. The peak

impact of the Pratt & Whitney inspection programme after an
identiﬁed production issue has passed, but checks and
maintenance continue to constrain parts of the A320neo-
family ﬂeet and absorb scarce maintenance capacity.

Delivery catch-up is crucial for both
capacity and efﬁciency
New aircraft are critical not only to accommodate growth, but also
to improve eﬃciency. The average age of the global ﬂeet has
increased from around 13 to 15 years since 2019 due to production
constraints.
This matters increasingly as older units require more maintenance

at a time when skilled personnel and maintenance capacity are
scarce; they also consume signiﬁcantly more fuel and therefore
emit more.
Boeing is ﬁnally regaining altitude
supporting deliveries
Boeing is ﬁnally making a sustained comeback following an
unprecedented period of disruption stemming from the 737 MAX
accidents, the pandemic and subsequent production and quality
problems. It received certiﬁcation for its 737 MAX 7 and also the
737 MAX 10 recently. Boeing plans to increase production for the

family from 38 to 47 a month.

Higher 737 production should support deliveries in 2027 and
gradually bring pre-pandemic production levels back into sight. This
is hugely important for Boeing-dependent airlines such as Ryanair
and Southwest. Progress on certiﬁcation of the 777-9 is also
important for long-haul ﬂeet renewal.
Fleet renewal is currently the most
important decarbonisation lever
Air travel continues to grow, and associated emissions tend to
continue to rise further as well. Sustainable aviation fuels are

labelled as an important industry pathway to decarbonise, but
globally, blend rates still hover below 1% in 2026.
The closure of airspaces, too, has created ineﬃciencies and extra
emissions over the last few years, undermining gains elsewhere.
Around 63% of the global ﬂeet still consists of previous-generation
aircraft. Replacing them can reduce fuel consumption by 10-25% or
more, making ﬂeet renewal one of the most eﬀective near-term
decarbonisation levers available to airlines.

The challenge is to deliver proﬁtable growth
in a more disruptive world
For airlines, the challenge heading into 2027 is therefore not simply

ﬁnding suﬃcient demand. Relatively poor punctuality, with only
around 61% of ﬂights departing on time in 2026 year-to-date, is a
signal.
The globally operating industry faces more turbulence and
uncertainty amid intensiﬁed geopolitical risks. The challenge is to
deliver proﬁtable growth in a world of persistently constrained
capacity, higher costs and more frequent disruption.

感測器可能成為未來供應鏈中的關鍵瓶頸。
► 機器人在實體世界中執行任務時 ，任何延遲
或連線中斷都可能帶來重大風險 ，因此相較
純數位的 AI應用 ，對即時運算 (邊緣運算 )能
力的要求更高 。而近幾年邊緣運算軟硬體能
力大幅提升 ，使本地端設備得以部署數十億
參數的 AI模型 ，並將反應延遲縮短至約 0.3
秒，使機器人能夠即時感知 、決策與行動 。
此外，過去6年風險資本對機器人、感測器及
IT 硬體的每年平均投資約 100 億美元 ， 但
2026年僅上半年即已達 280億美元 ，暗示市
場對機器人產業潛力的期待有別於過往。

Economy 
Kicking and screaming: Child care costs persist 
20 October 2026

Key takeaways 
• Child care remains a growing financial burden for many households, even as growth in the median payment has moderated, 
according to Bank of America payments data. More families are paying more than $2,000 per month for care, suggesting 
affordability pressures are becoming increasingly concentrated among households facing the highest expenses. 
• Child care cost pressures vary significantly across the country. Nashville and Jacksonville, FL posted the fastest year-over-year 
growth among major metro areas, while New York and Washington DC saw the biggest decrease in median payment growth, 
according to Bank of America payments data. 
• Limited supply may continue to constrain access to child care for some households. Child care employment fell 0.7% year-over-
year in September, suggesting provider capacity remains under pressure and could continue to affect household finances and 
labor force participation.

Child care costs outpace rent and medical services 
Child care remains a significant expense for many families. In September, the growth in child care and other school-related fees 
surpassed other major household expenses such as rent and medical services, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) 
(Exhibit 1). 
Yet, while child care prices continue to rise in official inflation data, median household payments have largely moderated since 
February, according to Bank of America data (Exhibit 2). More importantly, the growth in the number of households paying for 
child care has fallen since the start of 2025.

fall even as prices continue rising.  
The decline in the number of households paying for child care may also reflect families seeking alternatives to formal care 
arrangements. Some may be relying more heavily on relatives, shifting parents’ work schedules or dropping out of the workforce 
altogether to care for their children in response to elevated costs. This could explain why, among all income groups paying for 
care, the number of lower-income households has seen the biggest decline, falling 2.0% year-over-year (YoY) in September 
(Exhibit 3). 
Exhibit 3: The number of lower-income households paying for child care has fallen the most, down 2.0% YoY in September 
Number of households with child care payments (monthly, three-month moving average, YoY%)

Source: Bank of America internal data  
BANK OF AMERICA INSTITUTE 
More families face larger monthly bills 
Yet even as fewer households pay for child care, the share of those shelling out more than $2,000 per month has increased 
substantially (Exhibit 4). In fact, it has more than doubled since 2023, reaching 7.7% in 2026 year-to-date. Meanwhile, the share 
of those paying $1,000 or less has declined, suggesting higher monthly payments are becoming more common even as the 
national median grows more slowly. 
Exhibit 4: The share of households paying >$2000 a month for child care has more than doubled since 2023 
Monthly child care payments by amount (annual average, share of households, %)

Source: Bank of America internal data  
BANK OF AMERICA INSTITUTE 
Rising costs take a bigger bite out of households’ paychecks 
What makes child care “affordable”? According to the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, child care is considered 
affordable if it accounts for no more than 7% of family income. Yet, in Bank of America data, the average child care cost was 8% 
in September.  
While an 8% share may not appear dramatically above the federal affordability benchmark of 7%, it represents an average across 
households’ income levels. For families in high-cost metro areas or those paying more than $2,000 per month, the burden is 
likely considerably higher.

Where child care costs are climbing 
Child care pressures also differ substantially by location. In Bank of America payments data, Nashville posted the fastest YoY 
median payment growth in September, followed by Jacksonville, FL and Phoenix (Exhibit 6). This dispersion of growth across the 
country suggests child care cost pressures are no longer confined to historically expensive coastal markets.  
Interestingly, New York and Washington DC saw the sharpest decline in growth this year. Why might this be? The supply side of 
the market may help explain why – for example, New York City recently introduced universal Pre-K.1

Fewer providers, higher costs 
As of September 2026, employment in child care services was down 0.7% from a year earlier, suggesting the sector’s workforce 
recovery has stalled. Fewer workers can constrain the number of available places or the hours providers offer. That may leave 
families facing longer searches, fewer workable arrangements or continued price pressure. In turn, access to care can influence 
parents’ ability to enter, remain in or expand their participation in the workforce. 
Exhibit 7: Employment within child care services fell 0.7% YoY in September 
Employees by sector (monthly, seasonally adjusted, YoY%)

Source: Haver Analytics  
BANK OF AMERICA INSTITUTE 
What are the economic implications of rising child care costs? 
Child care costs may have important labor market implications for families with young children. Of those households paying for 
child care in 2026, more than half of them were Older Millennials (52%), followed by Younger Millennials (20%) and Gen X (16%), 
according to Bank of America payments data. This means child care costs weigh more heavily on Older Millennials. 
The share of Older Millennial households receiving more than one paycheck has continued to grow from a year earlier, but the 
pace of that improvement has moderated over the past three months (Exhibit 8). Given that this group accounts for the majority 
of households paying for child care in Bank of America payments data, they may offer early signs of how affordability affects 
their employment decisions. 
Exhibit 8: The share of Older Millennial households paying for child care that have more than one person with a paycheck has declined since 2021  
Share of households with a child care payment with more than one person with a paycheck (%, monthly, three-month moving average)

Source: Bank of America internal data  
BANK OF AMERICA INSTITUTE 
Child care challenges can weigh on women’s employment 
According to data from the American Time Use Survey, women continue to perform significantly more child care and household 
work than men, even as their participation in paid work has increased. This suggests that persistent gaps in access and 
affordability may have disproportionate consequences for women’s employment. Indeed, the percentage of women who cited 
child care as a reason for temporary unemployment was nearly three times higher than men’s in 2026, though the average fell 
from 2025, according to data from the BLS. 
Yet labor force participation data indicates a more nuanced picture. Despite persistent child care pressures, mothers are 
participating in the workforce at rates that remain above their 2019 averages.

Methodology 
Selected Bank of America transaction data is used to inform the macroeconomic views expressed in this report and should be considered in the 
context of other economic indicators and publicly available information. In certain instances, the data may provide directional and/or predictive 
value. The data used is not comprehensive; it is based on aggregated and anonymized selections of Bank of America data and may reflect a 
degree of selection bias and limitations on the data available. 
Bank of America credit/debit card spending per household includes spending from active US households only. Only consumer card holders 
making a minimum of five transactions a month are included in the dataset. Spending from corporate cards is excluded. Data regarding 
merchants who receive payments are identified and classified by the Merchant Categorization Code (MCC) defined by financial services 
companies. The data are mapped using proprietary methods from the MCCs to the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), 
which is also used by the Census Bureau, in order to classify spending data by subsector. Spending data may also be classified by other 
proprietary methods not using MCCs.  
If applicable, the consumer deposit data based on Bank of America internal data is derived by anonymizing and aggregating data from Bank of 
America consumer deposit accounts in the US and analyzing that data at a highly aggregated level.  
If applicable, any payments data represents aggregated spend from US Retail, Preferred, Small Business and Wealth Management clients with a 
deposit account or credit card. Any reference to aggregated spend include total credit card, debit card, ACH, wires, bill pay, business/peer-to-
peer, cash and checks.  
Unless otherwise stated, data is not adjusted for seasonality, processing days or portfolio changes, and may be subject to periodic revisions.  
Additional information about the methodology used to aggregate the data is available upon request.

CENTRAL BANK MEETINGS

Bank of Thailand (BOT) (October 28)

We expect the BOT to maintain its policy 
rate at 1.00% at its 28 October meeting, 
extending its pause for a fourth 
consecutive decision as it balances 
inflationary pressures against uneven 
and subdued economic growth. Our view 
is aligned with fixed market income 
pricing. Headline inflation rose anew to 
2.8% yoy in September 2026, driven by 
higher energy, food, and core price 
increases, but remained within the upper 
end of the central bank’s 1 -3% target 
range. As the BOT is still likely to look 
through what it views as temporary, 
supply-driven inflationary pressu res, it 
will likely refrain from tightening policy, 
and keep interest rates accommodative 
to support the soft and uneven growth 
cycle.

European Central Bank (October 29)

We expect the ECB to extend its pause, 
keeping the deposit facility rate at 2.5%. 
Market participants will instead focus on 
the central bank’s assessment of rising 
French and Italian bond yields and 
widening spreads versus Bunds. While 
we do not expect dir ect references to 
individual countries, the ECB is likely to 
signal that recent developments in 
France reflect the country’s weaker 
fiscal and debt profile rather than a 
broader systemic concern. Policymakers 
will seek to differentiate between a 
localised bond sell -off and a Eurozone -
wide market disruption, justifying their 
decision to monitor developments rather 
than implement specific measures at this 
juncture. Meanwhile, inflation continues 
to rise, with little relief expected in 
upcoming readings given elevated 
global fuel prices. 
Bank of Japan (October 30)

The Bank of Japan is expected to keep 
the overnight call rate unchanged at 1.25% 
at this meeting, pausing after the 25bp 
hike in September. The BOJ is likely to 
assess the impact of the previous rate 
hike before taking further action. The 
recent stabilisat ion of the yen also 
reduces the urgency of another hike at 
this meeting.

The tightening bias should remain intact. 
Growth and inflation remain broadly on 
track, leaving room for the BOJ to revise 
up its FY2026 –FY2027 GDP and CPI 
forecasts. Wage growth has also 
remained strong, with Rengo reportedly 
targeting wage increases of 6% in 2027, 
reinforcing the BOJ’s confidence that 
underlying inflation can be sustained 
around its 2% target. We continue to 
expect the policy rate to rise to 1.50% in 
December 2026 or January 2027, 
followed by a further increase to 1.75% 
by 2Q 2027.

FORTHCOMING DATA 
RELEASES

Hong Kong SAR

Export growth is expected to accelerate 
from 53.0% yoy in August to 55.0% in 
September, in line with the pickup in 
China’s export growth from 25.0% to 
36.3%. As a key re-export hub for China,

### Page 3

The Week Ahead October 23, 2026 
                                                                                                                                         3

Hong Kong should benefit from robust 
AI-related electronics trade, with 
electrical machinery, equipment and 
parts exports to Hong Kong accounting 
for 20.6% of China’s total exports. 
Import growth is also expected to remain 
firm, supported by resilient expo rt 
orders and gradually improving 
investment sentiment, sustaining 
demand for intermediate and capital 
goods.

Singapore

Singapore’s industrial production (IP) 
likely remained in expansion for a 13th 
consecutive month in September 2026, 
although we expect growth to moderate 
to 7.6% yoy from August’s strong 15.4% 
yoy pace. IP growth continued to be 
underpinned by the electronics and 
precision engineering clusters, which 
has been key drivers of Singapore’s 
manufacturing strength, reflecting 
sustained demand for artificial 
intelligence-related hardware. However, 
performance across clusters remained 
uneven, with chemicals and biomedical 
manufacturing likely contracting, and 
tempering overall gains.

South Korea

The preliminary estimate for 3Q26 GDP 
is likely to show growth remaining solid 
at 3.2% yoy , slightly below 3.7% in 2Q 
and 3.8% in 1Q. Nominal GDP growth is 
likely to remain in double digits, 
significantly outpacing real GDP growth, 
thanks to improved terms of trade amid 
rising memory export prices. By 
expenditure, exports picked up in 3Q in 
both nominal and real terms, supported 
by stronger semiconductor shipments. 
Investment also appeared robust, as 
reflected in the equipment investment 
estimation index and machinery order 
index. Private consumption, however, 
appeared to weaken amid the sharp 
KOSPI correction since July following  
the introduction of leveraged ETF 
regulations. Our full -year GDP growth 
forecasts of 3.5% for 2026 and 2.4% for 
2027 remain on track.

Taiwan

The preliminary estimate for 3Q GDP is 
likely to show growth remaining strong 
at 12 –13% yoy , close to 12.9% in 2Q, 
albeit below the peak of 15.4% in 1Q. 
Exports maintained strong double -digit 
growth in 3Q (44.6% yoy  in nominal 
terms and 21.1% in real terms), supported 
by robust shipments of semiconductors, 
servers and other AI -related products. 
Machinery investment also sustained 
strong double-digit growth, underpinned 
by higher capacity utilisation in the ICT 
sector and a resulting increase in capital 
goods imports. Private consumption 
appeared to have strengthened further, 
supported by stock market gains, 
improving wage growth, and the 
associated wealth and income effects. 
Construction investment remained the 
weak s pot, weighed down by elevated 
inventories in the new-home market and 
the ongoing need for inventory digestion. 
We maintain our 2026 and 2027 GDP 
growth forecasts at 11.6% and 5.6%, 
respectively, with risks tilted to the 
upside.

### Page 1

AI 扫描漏洞速度已呈爆炸式增⻓ ——Anthropic 的 Mythos 模型开放⼀个⽉内，⼗余家公司
发现的开源漏洞从 1500 个暴增⾄ 37000 个。为应对危机，美国银⾏急招千⼈疯狂补漏，⾼
盛⾼管坦⾔，安全 AI ⽀出可能很快超越编程 AI 投⼊；某能源巨头 3000 万美元安全预算已提
前动⽤明年份额。
摘要：
AI 驱动的漏洞扫描⼯具正以前所未有的速度暴露软件缺陷，⽽企业修补漏洞的能⼒远远跟不上这
⼀节奏。这场 “ 攻守失衡 ” 正在催⽣⼀轮⼤规模的企业⽹络安全⽀出潮，从华尔街⼤⾏到能源巨
头，再到初创公司，⽆⼀幸免。
据科技媒体 The Information 10 ⽉ 28 ⽇报道，美国银⾏近期披露，正招募 1000 名承包商，借助
Anthropic 的 Mythos 等 AI ⼯具修补⾃⾝软件漏洞。⾼盛则已⼤量使⽤ Mythos 和 OpenAI 的 Astra
模型在内部系统中主动搜寻漏洞，据⼀位与⾼盛管理层有过交流的知情⼈⼠透露，⾼盛⾼管已
在讨论：公司在安全领域的 AI ⽀出，可能很快将追平甚⾄超过其在 AI 编程⼯具上的投⼊—— ⽽

后者此前⼀直是⾼盛最⼤的 AI 相关开⽀项⽬。⼀家美国⼤型能源供应商的⾸席信息安全官也透
露，该公司今年⽹络安全预算约为 3000 万美元，同⽐增幅超过 10% ，并已将明年的预算提前动
⽤，以⽀付相关 AI 功能的额外费⽤。
这场⽀出潮的直接受益者包括 Palo Alto Networks 、 Proofpoint 、 Cisco 旗下 Splunk 等安全软件⼚
商，以及 OpenAI 、 Anthropic 等⼤模型提供商。 Palo Alto Networks 最近两个财季的营收增速已
翻倍⾄逾 30% 。与此同时，据 The Information 此前报道，多家利⽤⼤模型⾃动化安全职能的⽹
络安全初创公司，也正在收到收购⽅的接触。
漏洞爆发： AI 发现速度远超⼈⼯修补能⼒
这场危机的核⼼⽭盾，在于 AI 发现漏洞的速度与企业修复漏洞的能⼒之间存在巨⼤落差。
据报道， Palo Alto Networks ⾸席产品与技术官 Lee Klarich 提供了⼀组数字，直观呈现了这⼀问

题的规模：今年 5 ⽉， Anthropic 向约⼗余家科技和⽹络安全公司开放其 Mythos 模型访问权限，
当⽉全球开源软件新报告漏洞总数约为 1500 个。仅仅⼀个⽉后，这⼗余家公司仅凭 Mythos 发现
的新开源漏洞数量便超过 37000 个 —— 尽管并⾮所有漏洞都属于⾼危级别，也并⾮全部经过确认
或公开披露。
研究机构 Epoch AI 的数据进⼀步印证了这⼀趋势：仅今年 8 ⽉和 9 ⽉两个⽉内，被报告的 “ ⾼危漏
洞 ” 数量 —— 即可能对敏感数据构成严重威胁的漏洞 —— 就已超过 2025 年全年的总量。
这种爆发式增⻓给企业安全团队带来了巨⼤压⼒。全球 IT 服务公司 Diversified 的⾸席信息官 Viral
Tripathi 描述了该公司应对 PHP 漏洞和 Brotli 开源库漏洞时的混乱状态：
“ 这些修复⼯作耗费了⼤量资源，影响远不⽌于打⼀个补丁那么简单，占⽤了⼤量⽇常运营时
间， ”Tripathi 说。
公司不得不调动约 100 名 IT 员⼯中的⼤多数，包括平时并不直接从事⽹络安全⼯作的分析师和⼯

程师，全⼒排查哪些云应⽤和⽹⻚存在⻛险并安装补丁。

企业响应：招⼈、扩预算、引⼊ AI 代理
⾯对持续升级的威胁，企业的应对策略正在从被动响应转向主动防御，核⼼⼿段是加⼤⼈员招
募和 AI ⼯具投⼊。
企业软件初创公司 Atomicwork 的 CEO Vijay Rayapati 上周紧急召集约 30 名⼯程师，要求全员优

侵， AI 模型路由开源⼯具 LiteLLM 被攻破，以及被约 70% ⽹站使⽤的编程语⾔ PHP 被发现存在安
全漏洞。
据报道，尽管 Atomicwork 最终确认未受直接影响，但 Rayapati 表⽰，这场紧急响应本⾝就说明
“ 没有⼈做好准备 ” 。他计划未来每招募三名技术⼈员，就同步招募⼀名⽹络安全⼯程师，预计未

来⼀年内专注⽹络安全的⼯程师⼈数将从现有⽔平增⾄约 27 ⼈，⼤约翻三倍。
Diversified 同样计划新增⾄少三名全职⽹络安全⼈员，并将来年⽹络安全软件预算提⾼约 20% ，
重点投向⾃动化应⽤监控 AI ⼯具。
The Information 报道指出，那家不愿具名的美国⼤型能源供应商，则将新增预算⽤于 Mythos 等
AI ⼯具，以及其已在使⽤的安全产品的 AI 增强功能 —— 包括 Proofpoint 的邮件防护产品和 Cisco
Splunk 的数据监控产品。该公司 CISO 表⽰，这两家安全⼚商对持续监控 AI 功能额外收费，但这
对于应对⽇益普遍的、由 AI 驱动的持续性⿊客攻击⽽⾔是必要投⼊。
⼚商受益：安全⽀出潮成⾏业新常态
⽹络安全软件⼚商正从这轮⽀出潮中直接获益，并将其定性为⻓期结构性趋势，⽽⾮短期异
常。
Palo Alto Networks 的 Klarich 表⽰： “ 这是新常态的⼀部分。不要把它当作⼀次性紧急事件，⽽要
把它看作你基本上每天都需要应对的事情。 ” 该公司最近两个财季的营收增速已翻倍，超过 30% 。

OpenAI 和 Anthropic 也将⽹络安全需求视为明年销售增⻓的重要驱动⼒，部分原因正是来⾃ Palo
Alto Networks 等将其模型集成进产品的安全⼚商。
不过，企业在 AI 安全⼯具上的⽀出并⾮没有边界。 UiPath ⾸席信息安全官 Scott Roberts 表⽰，
该公司近期已通过转向更廉价的开源模型，削减了此前在 Mythos 等商业模型上的⽀出，以寻求
更具成本效益的替代⽅案。
前 Facebook ⽹络安全负责⼈、上⽉加⼊ AI 初创公司 Cognition 担任同⼀职务的 Alex Stamos ，对
整体形势给出了清醒判断：
“ 未来三到五年将是安全⾏业历史上最关键的时期。防御⽅在应对 AI 相关⻛险⽅⾯曾有先发优
势，部分原因是我们（企业防御⽅）资⾦更充裕。但攻击⽅已经在迎头赶上。 ”

Document 1472: 企業物価は鈍化も、上昇圧力はなお強い（26年9月企業物価指数） ～川下への価格転嫁が続く。資源高による再加速リスクも～

Source PDF: all report pdf/企業物価は鈍化も、上昇圧力はなお強い（26年9月企業物価指数） ～川下への価格転嫁が続く。資源高による再加速リスクも～.pdf
Report source: Unknown
Date: 未知日期
Pages: 4
Status: ok

### Page 1

Economic Trends

2026 年10 月 13 日

1/4 
企業物価は鈍化も、上昇圧力はなお強い（26 年 9 月企業物価指数） 
～川下への価格転嫁が続く。資源高による再加速リスクも～ 
 経済調査部 シニアエグゼクティブエコノミスト  新家 義貴 
（℡：050-5474-7490）

（要旨） 
○ ９月の国内企業物価指数は前月比▲0.3％、前年比＋6.8％（８月：前年比＋7.6％）。 前年比
上昇率は４ヵ月ぶりに＋７％を下回ったが、農林水産物や石油製品の下落による影響が大き
く、企業段階の物価上昇圧力はなお根強い。 
○ 川上・川中では価格上昇に一服感がみられる一方、川下のプラスチック製品では高い伸びが
続いている。既往のコスト高の価格転嫁はなお進んでおり、川下への物価上昇圧力は依然と
して強い。 
○ ＡＩ関連需要の拡大を背景に、半導体や銅などの価格上昇も目立つ。資源価格とは異なる経
路からの物価上昇圧力として注目される。 
○ 先行きは、川下への価格転嫁が続くなか、資源価格の高止まりによって川上からの上昇圧力
が再び強まるリスクがある。企業物価は当面高止まりし、消費者物価についても年度後半に
かけて上昇率を明確に高める可能性が高い。

1. 前年比は＋６％台に鈍化も、物価上昇圧力はなお根強い 
日本銀行から公表された2026 年９月の国内企業物価指数は、前月比▲0.3％、前年比＋6.8％と
なった。前月比では２ヵ月連続で下落し、前年比でも４ヵ月ぶりに＋７％を下回った。８月の前
年比＋7.6％から大きく鈍化しており、春先の急激な物価上昇には一服感がみられる。 
もっとも、企業段階での物価上昇圧力が大きく和らいだわけではない。今月は農林水産物や石
油・石炭製品の下落が全体の前月比を押し下げた一方、プラスチック製品など川下への価格転嫁
は続き、ＡＩ関連の価格上昇も目立った。また、足元の資源価格の高止まりを踏まえると、先行
きは川上からの上昇圧力が再び強まるリスクもあることにも注意が必要だ。 
前月比の内訳をみると、農林水産物が同▲8.8％（寄与度：▲0.42％ポイント）と大幅に下落し
た。玄米や精米、豚肉などが主な下落要因となった。米については、2026 年産米の概算金の引き
下げなどを背景に価格が大きく低下したとみられる。農林水産物は前年比でも▲13.3％と大幅な
マイナスとなっており、９月の企業物価を押し下げる大きな要因となった。

### Page 2

2/4 
また、石油・石炭製品も前月比▲2.2％と下落した（寄与度：▲0.15％ポイント） 。重油、軽
油、ジェット燃料油などの下落が影響している。農林水産物と石油・石炭製品のマイナス寄与は
合計▲0.57％ポイントと、国内企業物価全体の前月比▲0.3％を大きく上回っている。この２つを
除けばプラス寄与となっており、企業物価の下落が一部に集中していたことが分かる。 
実際、プラスチック製品が前月比＋1.1％、金属製品が同＋0.7％、化学製品が同＋0.3％、飲食
料品が同＋0.2％、電子部品・デバイスが同＋0.4％となるなど、多くの工業製品で価格上昇がみ
られた。また、報道によれば、日銀が公表する515 品目のうち、前年比で価格が上昇した品目は
460 品目と、全体の約９割に達している。国内企業物価の前年比上昇率は鈍化したものの、値上が
りは依然として幅広い品目に及んでいる。企業段階での物価上昇圧力はなお根強いとみるべきだ
ろう。

2. 川中価格は下落も、川下への価格転嫁は続く 
石油化学関連では、春先にみられた急激な価格上昇の反動が続いている。石油・石炭製品は前
月比▲2.2％と、３ヵ月連続で下落した。ベンゼンが同＋17.2％、キシレンが同＋6.0％と、川上
の石油化学系基礎製品の一部で上昇もみられるが、ベンゼンについては中国の製油所の定期修理
に伴う供給減少という個別要因も影響しているようだ。川上価格全体でみれば、このところやや
落ち着きもみられる。 
川中に位置する合成樹脂は前月比▲0.8％と、８月の同▲2.7％に続いて下落した。内訳をみて
も、ポリエチレンが同▲2.9％、ポリプロピレンが同▲0.2％となるなど、主要品目で下落が続い
ている。４月の川上価格急騰を受けて５～６月には合成樹脂への価格波及が進んだが、夏場以降
は反落が続いている。川中段階での追加的なコスト上昇圧力は弱まりつつあると言えそうだ。 
これに対して、川下価格の動きは対照的である。プラスチック製品は９月も前月比＋1.1％と上

### Page 3

3/4 
昇し、前年比では＋12.8％と８月の＋11.3％からさらに伸びを高めた。川中の合成樹脂価格が２
ヵ月連続で下落する一方、その先に位置するプラスチック製品では前年比上昇率がむしろ加速し
ており、川中と川下の価格動向の乖離が一段と鮮明になった。 
品目別にみても、価格上昇は最終製品に近い段階で続いている。９月はプラスチック製容器
（中空成形を除く）が前月比＋11.2％と大幅に上昇するなど、容器類を中心に価格上昇が続い
た。こうした包装資材は食品や日用品など幅広い商品に用いられるため、川下企業のコスト負担
を高める要因となる。 
こうした川中と川下の価格動向の違いの背景には、企業間の価格転嫁に時間差があることが挙
げられる。原材料価格が低下しても、川下企業の仕入れコストが直ちに下がるわけではない。高
値で調達した原材料の在庫が残っているほか、取引価格の改定も一定の間隔で行われるためであ
る。加えて、物流費や人件費など原材料以外のコスト上昇も続いている。９月の「合成樹脂の下
落とプラスチック製品の上昇」という組み合わせは、既往のコスト高の価格転嫁が川下でなお続
いていることを示すものといえる。 
また、今回の企業物価では、ＡＩ関連需要の拡大を背景とする価格上昇も注目される。９月の
輸出物価指数は契約通貨ベースで前月比＋1.4％となったが、このうち電気・電子機器の寄与度は
＋0.80％ポイントと、上昇の半分以上を占めた。輸入物価でもモス型メモリ集積回路や銅鉱など
が上昇しており、世界的なＡＩ・データセンター需要の拡大による影響がうかがわれる。ＡＩ関
連需要の拡大は日本の輸出や企業収益にとって追い風となる一方、半導体や銅などの調達コスト
上昇を通じて、国内の関連製品価格を押し上げる側面もある。資源価格とは異なる経路からの物
価上昇圧力として、今後の動向が注目される。

3. 川下転嫁と資源高で、物価上昇圧力は長期化へ 
先行きについては、既往のコスト高の川下への価格転嫁が今後もしばらく続く可能性が高い。
川中の合成樹脂価格が下落する一方、川下のプラスチック製品では値上がりが続いており、原材
料価格の低下が川下価格の押し下げにつながるまでには、なお時間を要するとみられる。物流費
や人件費などを含めた企業のコスト水準も依然として高く、価格転嫁の動きは簡単には収まらな
いだろう。 
加えて、資源価格の再上昇による新たなコスト上昇圧力にも注意が必要だ。９月の輸入物価指
数は円ベースでは前月比▲0.2％と小幅な下落となったものの、契約通貨ベースでは同＋1.0％と
上昇に転じた。なかでも石油・石炭・天然ガスは契約通貨ベースで同＋2.3％、円ベースでも同＋
0.9％と上昇している。資源価格再上昇の影響がラグをもって輸入物価押し上げにつながること
で、10 月の輸入物価は上昇に転じる可能性が高まっている。こうした動きが国内の石油・化学関
連価格に時間差を伴って波及すれば、川上からの物価上昇圧力が再び強まることになる。 
このため、国内企業物価の前年比上昇率は９月に＋６％台へ鈍化したものの、今後も当面＋
６％台を中心とした高い伸びが続く可能性が高い。農林水産物の価格下落は引き続き企業物価の
押し下げ要因となる可能性がある一方、既往のコスト高の川下転嫁が続くなか、資源価格や為替

### Page 4

経済研究所が信ずるに足ると判断した情報に基づき作成していますが、その正確性、完全性に対する責任は負いません。見通しは予告
なく変更されることがあります。また、記載された内容は、第一生命保険ないしはその関連会社の投資方針と常に整合的であるとは限
りません。
4/4
を通じた新たなコスト上昇が重なれば、企業物価の明確な鈍化には時間を要するだろう。
消費者物価への影響にも注意が必要である。米価格の下落は食料品価格を押し下げる要因とな
るものの、米以外の食料品では上昇圧力が強まる可能性が高い。プラスチック製容器など包装資
材の価格上昇が続いているほか、物流費や人件費なども高止まりしており、こうしたコスト増が
時間差を伴って最終販売価格へ転嫁されるとみられる。米価下落が一定の下押し要因となるなか
でも、食料品全体では年度後半にかけて価格上昇圧力が強まると予想している。
総じてみれば、９月の企業物価は、農林水産物や石油製品の下落によって全体の上昇率が鈍化
したものの、川下への価格転嫁はなお続き、ＡＩ関連の価格上昇も目立つ結果となった。先行き

は、既往のコスト高の価格転嫁が続くなか、資源価格の高止まりによって川上からの上昇圧力が
再び強まるリスクもある。企業物価は当面高い伸びが続く可能性が高いだろう。
消費者物価についても、既往のコスト高の価格転嫁が続くことで、上昇圧力が強まるとみられ
る。筆者は、26 年末から27 年初にかけて消費者物価上昇率が前年比＋３％を上回ると予想してお
り、今回の企業物価指数もこうした見通しと整合的な結果だったと考えている。当面、物価の上
振れに警戒が必要な局面が続くだろう。

三季度公募基⾦平均仓位降⾄ 78.32% 。重仓股迎来⼤洗牌：宁德时代、腾讯、茅台排名⼤
幅滑落，降⾄第 7 、第 20 和第 22 位；前 50 ⼤重仓股中， AI 概念股⾼达 32 只强势霸屏，医药
股占据 8 席。
摘要：
根据最新披露的公募基⾦三季报，今年三季度，光模块⻰头中际旭创再度蝉联公募头号重仓
股，新易盛和药明康德分列第⼆、第三重仓股。值得注意的是，今年 7 ⽉底上市的⻓鑫科技，成
为公募第四⼤重仓股，宁德时代滑落成公募第七⼤重仓股，腾讯控股降⾄第⼆⼗⼤重仓股，贵
州茅台是公募基⾦第⼆⼗⼆⼤重仓股。
值得注意的是，在这份公募重仓排名清单⾥，只出现⼀只银⾏股，宁波银⾏位列第 41 名。
可⽐基⾦平均仓位 78.32%
天相投顾数据显⽰，截⾄ 2026 年三季度末，全部可⽐基⾦平均仓位为 78.32% ，较 2026 年⼆季度
末的 81.61% 降低 3.29 个百分点。其中，股票型开放式基⾦和混合型开放式基⾦的平均仓位分别
为 88.04% 和 76.78% ，较⼆季度末分别降低 0.39 和 3.76 个百分点。

今年三季度，在多重因素扰动下， A 股市场⻛格出现明显切换，以煤炭、银⾏等为代表的价值⻛
格显著占优，前期领涨的科技成⻓赛道则出现震荡调整。
尽管市场波动加⼤，多位基⾦经理仍在三季报中传递出对 A 股后市相对积极的判断。万家宏观择
时多策略基⾦经理⻩海表⽰，虽然外部冲击仍可能反复，但经过前期调整，部分资产的估值与
交易结构已有所改善，四季度 A 股有望在震荡中逐步企稳转强。
永赢惠添盈⼀年混合基⾦经理许拓认为，四季度 A 股市场⼤概率维持震荡整固格局，向上向下空
间均相对有限，但结构性机会仍然存在。⼀⽅⾯，美联储重启加息叠加欧洲通胀压⼒，全球流
动性环境边际趋紧，⻛险偏好或受压制；另⼀⽅⾯，经过三季度的回调， AI 科技产业链的估值压
⼒有所释放，部分优质标的配置价值开始显现。
“ 展望四季度， A 股市场将进⼊震荡筑底、均衡修复的收官阶段，⾏情有望转向 ‘ ⾼景⽓科技 + 低估
值修复 ’ 双轮驱动。 ” 新华趋势领航混合基⾦经理蔡春红称。
⻓鑫科技成公募第四⼤持仓
天相投顾数据显⽰，截⾄ 2026 年三季度末，科技股依然霸屏公募基⾦重仓股名单。其中，光模

块⻰头中际旭创再度蝉联公募头号重仓股，新易盛和药明康德分列第⼆、第三重仓股。⻓鑫科
技位居第四，源杰科技位居第五。
从热⻔上市公司看，宁德时代滑落成公募第七⼤重仓股，腾讯控股降⾄第⼆⼗⼤重仓股，贵州
茅台是公募基⾦第⼆⼗⼆⼤重仓股。
数据显⽰，公募基⾦前五⼗⼤重仓股，主要分布在 AI 相关⾏业和医药⾏业，其中 AI 相关公司⾼达
32 只，包括光模块概念股中际旭创、新易盛，半导体制造领域相关的北⽅华创、中微公司、中
科⻜测、拓荆科技、⻓川科技， PCB 相关的沪电股份、⽣益科技、深南电路、东⼭精密等，以
及芯⽚相关的寒武纪、海光信息、圣邦股份。
⾸⻚ 资讯 快讯 ⾏情 ⽇历 APP VIP 会员 ⼤师课 ⻅闻历 搜索

### Page 2

值得注意的是，在公募最新前五⼗⼤重仓股中，有⼋只医药股，包括创新药领域的恒瑞医药、
海思科、信达⽣物、科伦药业，以及 CXO 相关的药明康德、康⻰化成、泰格医药、凯莱英和药
明⽣物。
从持仓市值来看，截⾄ 2026 年三季度末，共有 1557 只基⾦持有中际旭创，合计持仓市值为
959.38 亿元； 1189 只基⾦重仓持有新易盛，合计 870.78 亿元； 1083 只基⾦重仓持有药明康德，
合计 446.81 亿元； 959 只基⾦重仓持有⻓鑫科技，合计 428.52 亿元。
积极调仓挖掘结构性机会
根据基⾦三季报，多位基⾦经理积极进⾏了调仓换股，在控制净值波动的同时，寻找结构性投
资机会。
易⽅达产业机遇混合基⾦经理杨宗昌表⽰，三季度增加了 CXO （医药研发外包）、煤炭、有⾊⾦
属及机械设备⾏业的配置，组合⾏业配置更为分散、均衡。
华商改⾰创新股票基⾦经理刘⼒表⽰，三季度他继续重点配置壁垒⾼、空间⼤的半导体和创新
药板块。 “ 此外，上半年⾮ AI 板块⽆差别回调，有⼀批优质标的被错杀，这提供了很好的中期买

⼊机会，我们也积极挖掘兼具赔率和胜率的品种。 ”
嘉实成⻓增强混合基⾦经理陈涛表⽰，三季度组合主要增加了光通信、 AI 端侧、半导体测试以及
有⾊⾦属等⽅向的持仓；减少了前期涨幅较⼤的存储芯⽚、半导体设备和材料板块的持仓。
“ 我们对 AI 算⼒的部分持仓进⾏了减仓，以平滑组合波动、增强组合防御性；同时增加了 AI 应⽤
和端侧 AI 的标的。我们认为，随着时间的发展，算⼒存量的增加以及成本下降， AI 应⽤有望成为
重要投资主线。 ” 嘉实科技创新混合基⾦经理王贵重称。
看好 AI ⻓期发展趋势
三季度，科技板块震荡调整，从整体来看，基⾦经理们依然看好 AI ⻓期发展趋势，但强调在投资
中需要更加紧密跟踪产业发展趋势和关注上市公司业绩。
“ 总体⽽⾔， AI 产业继续在波折中前进， AI 产业对于社会的增量价值的创造刚刚开始，各种下游
应⽤开始百花⻬放并深刻改变我们的社会和⽣活，我们依然对产业有坚定的信⼼。 ” 华商均衡成⻓
混合基⾦经理张明昕表⽰，将以 AI 上下游全产业链景⽓的可验证程度、供需格局的边际变化、产

品的放量进度与筹码结构的演变为核⼼标准，对持仓进⾏动态优化。
在鹏华价值驱动混合基⾦经理张华恩看来，个股选择将成为接下来获取超额收益的关键。⽆论
是 AI 板块的去伪存真，还是其他⾏业的内部分化，⼤概率将成为未来很⻓时间的主旋律。其中，
国产模型的进步带动国产芯⽚的渗透加速，进⽽带动国内半导体⾏业的超级扩产周期，国产半
导体设备和零部件有望迎来⼀轮⼤的产业地位跃迁。
东吴移动互联混合基⾦经理刘元海认为，三季度 A 股市场科技股股价调整幅度和时间相对⽐较充
分，并且基本⾯存在⽐较⼤预期差。当前相对⽐较关注 AI 海外算⼒产业链以及国产算⼒产业链投
资机会，包括光模块、 PCB 、 AI 服务器和存储及与其相关的半导体设备等。

聯發科 
(2454.TW /2454 TT)

3Q26 財報前瞻  – 生產問題仍為潛在隱憂  
重要訊息 
聯發科將於 10 月 30 日召開法說會並公佈 3Q26 財報。 
評論及分析  
3Q26 營運表現可望優於市場共識及公司財測 。聯發科 3Q26 營收 1,680 億
元，季增 10.4%，較公司財測上緣高出 5%，亦較我們預估及市場共識高出
5-8%。我們認為營收優於預期主要受惠於旗艦手機 SoC 天璣 9600 提前拉
貨，以及通訊晶片需求維持強勁。隨著營運槓桿改善，我們預估 3Q26 營益
率將較 2Q26 的 15%提升 1.4ppts 至 16.4%。  
4Q26 營收成長可能略低於先前預期 。展望 4Q26，我們預期公司將提 出營
收強勁季增的財測，惟 AI ASIC 專案量產爬坡將使利潤率小幅下滑。我們預
估 4Q26 營收季增 34%，低於先前預估的 48%，主要考量：(1) 3Q26 比較
基期墊高；(2) 4Q26 智慧型手機需求轉弱；以及 (3) Zebrafish 於 4Q26 的量
產爬坡進度略低於預期。聯發科於上次法說會將 2026 年 AI ASIC 營收目標
由 20 億美元上修至超過 20 億美元，惟考量生產端的不確定性，我們預估
2026 年 AI ASIC 營收將略低於 20 億美元。  
Humufish 量產面臨瓶頸，惟 2028 年 Zebrafish 出貨量有上修空 間。我們
先前報告指出，由於 IC 載板供應短缺及生產良率仍存在不確定性，
Humufish 於 Intel EMIB -T 產線的量產爬坡時程已由 4Q27 延後至 2Q28，因
此我們認為市場對 Humufish 可能於 1Q27 重新流片的疑慮過度。然而，根
據相關供應鏈查核，考量零組件短缺及設計修改造成的時程延宕，我們將
2028 年 Humufish 出貨量預估由 330 萬顆下修至 200 萬顆。另一方面，目
前並未觀察到 TPU 需求放緩的跡象，因此我們將 2028 年 Zebrafish 出貨量
預估由 80 萬顆上修至 180 萬顆。考量整體出貨量預估較先前下修 8-10%，
且 Zebrafish 的 ASP 遠低於 Humufish ，我們將聯發科 2028 年 AI ASIC 營收
預估下修 28%，由 500 億美元降至 360 億美元，仍年增 139%。 
投資建議 
我們維持以 2028 年景氣循環高峰本益比 25 倍作為目標價評價基準，惟因
下修獲利預估，將目標價下調至 5,500 元。考量 TPU 需求強勁成長，以及聯
發科在 AI ASIC 市場的市占率持續提升，聯發科仍為我們半導體產業首選標
的之一，維持「增加持股」評等。  
投資風險  
智慧型手機出貨衰退；AI 晶片進展放緩。

ESG圖表定義 
項目 定義 說明 
能源使用 
直接與間接能源消耗總量(十億焦耳) 
- 公司運營範圍內消耗之能源總量 
- 能源使用總量 = 直接能源消耗總量 + 間接能源消耗量 
- 總能源使用量包括購買的能源、生產的能源 
- 就公用事業而言，輸電/電網損耗為其業務活動之一部分，被視為總能源消耗，數據不包括
為滿足能源使用而生產的電力(公用事業為出售而生產) 
- 就公用事業而言，用於能源生產的煤、天然氣或核能等原料不屬於「總能源使用」項下

購買之再生能源 
Primary再生能源購買總量(十億焦耳) 
- 公司各種來源之能源消耗量與購買的能源中屬於自然界可再生者(太陽能、風能、水能、生
物質能、地熱能)之量 
- 如無證據顯示再生能源由公司生產，則所報告的能源數據視為購買的再生能源 
聯發科對其辦公大樓與內部管
理流程進行了碳足跡驗證。 
再生能源使用率 再生能源占總能源消耗量之比例  
CO2約當排放量 
直接 CO2與 CO2約當排放量(公噸) 
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量(範圍 1排放量) 
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳(CO2)、甲烷(CH4)、一氧化二氮(N2O)、氫氟碳化物(HFCS)、全氟化合
物(PFCS)、六氟化硫(SF6)、三氟化氮(NF3)

CO2約當排放量營收比 
直接 CO2與 CO2約當排放量(公噸)銷售(百萬元)比 
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量(範圍 1排放量) 
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳(CO2)、甲烷(CH4)、一氧化二氮(N2O)、氫氟碳化物(HFCS)、全氟化合
物(PFCS)、六氟化硫(SF6)、三氟化氮(NF3)

廢棄物總量 
廢棄物總量(公噸) 
- 總廢棄物 = 無害廢棄物 + 有害廢棄物 
- 僅考慮固體廢棄物，但如液體廢棄物以公噸為單位呈報，則會將其加入求得包含液體廢棄
物之總量 
- 對於採礦、石油與天然氣等行業，tailings、廢石、煤、飛灰等廢棄物亦考慮在內

廢棄物回收率 
公司呈報的廢棄物回收率 
- 廢棄物回收率 = 廢棄物回收量/總廢棄物*100 
- 廢棄物轉化為能源或經由廢棄物焚燒產生能源視為廢棄物回收 
- 經由堆肥回收的廢棄物視為回收之廢棄物

總取水量 
總取水量(立方公尺) 
- 由呈報組織直接或經水公司等中介機構從任何水源抽取的總水量 
- 水井、城鎮/公用事業/市政用水、河水、地表水等不同之水源均予以考慮

環保支出 
環保支出總金額 
- 所有用於環境保護，或防止、減少、控制環境因素、影響、危害的投資與支出，亦包括處
置、處理、衛生、清理支出

員工流動率 
員工流動率 
- 包括任何原因(自願或非自願)離開公司的員工，如辭職、退休、自然離職/死亡、醫療失
能、冗員、裁員、重組、解僱、裁減或定期合約到期 
- 員工流動率 = (離開之員工/平均員工人數)*100 
- 平均員工人數 = (本年末員工人數 + 去年末員工人數)/2 
- 本財年末員工數 = 上個財年末員工數 + 新員工數 - 離開之員工數 
公司已揭露 2019-20 年留任
率，且人力資源部推出薪酬更
優渥之創新計劃以留住人才。 
女性經理 
女性經理百分比 
- 女性經理占公司經理的百分比 
- 如有不同階層之百分比，如最高階、高階、中階、初階，則會考慮中階女性經理之百分比 
- 女性經理百分比 = 女性經理人數/經理總數*100

女性員工 
女性員工百分比 
- 女性員工占公司員工總數的百分比 
- 女性員工百分比 = 女性人數/員工總數*100

教育訓練總時數 
所有員工教育訓練總時數 
- 僅考慮員工教育訓練時數 
- 包括一般員工所有類型的教育訓練(如健康與安全、環境、急難事件救援、技能與職業發展) 
- 如果數據以天為單位，則乘以 8，係假設 1天 = 8小時工作

每位員工教育訓練時數 平均每年每位員工總教育訓練時數  
資料來源：Refinitiv，公司資料，凱基

動態更新  印刷電路板 ‧ 台灣

欣興 
(3037.TW /3037 TT)

ABF 載板擴產能見度直達 2029 
重要訊息 
公司公布 3Q26 季報，毛利率及營利率 28.8%、20% 優共識 27.6%、
19.4%，在業外挹注 26.4 億下，淨利達 100.5 億，每股盈餘 6.1 元優共識
4.14 元。 
評論及分析 
3Q26 獲利優預期，4Q26 漲價效應持續 。3Q26 營收 526.5 億元，季增
23%、年增 55%，優共識 4.8%，毛利率上升來自於漲價效應、 AI 產品占
比提升、產能利用率維持高檔；業外淨收益 26.4 億元，主要為 金融資產評
價利益 15.6 億元。 技術別應用中 ABF 載板營收比重達 55%、BT 載板
7% 、 HDI 27% ；產品應用 中 AI Data Center 61% 、 IoT 18% 、
Communication 5% 、Automotive 4 %。3Q26 稼動率，ABF 載板維持 90% 
以上；BT 載板約 75-80%；PCB/HDI 稼動率落在 85-90%。 
與終端大廠簽署產能預訂協議 ，2027-29 ABF 產能每年 30%年成長。除
NVIDIA(美)外，公司與其他終端大廠亦簽署產能 3-5 年不等預訂協議，由客
戶先行提供資金或產能預訂支持，協助公司擴充高階 ABF 載板產能。其餘摘
要如下：(1)  除了 2026 年資本支出為 537 億元外，公司預期 27-29 每年將
開出一個新 ABF 廠，我們推估 2027-28 年每年資本支出達 400 億以上。
2026 ABF 產能可年增 40%，27-29 年皆可年增近 30%幅度，來自於 2027-
29 分別新增光復二廠、楊梅二廠、楊梅三廠。 (2)26- 27 年光模塊產能年增
率為 50%、40%，2026 營收佔比 9-10%。(3)2H26  AI 產品佔比，載板約
70%、PCB/HDI 65 -70%與先前看法一致。  
投資建議  
由於 3Q26 季報優預期，2027 -29 年 ABF 載板正步入缺口擴大上升週期，驅
動漲價效應擴大及組合優化 ，我們上調 2027 獲利 45%，維持「增加持股」
評等、調升目標價至 1650 元，相當於 2027 年每股盈餘 36 倍本益比。  
投資風險  
供過於求造成價格壓力 ，擴廠效益與市場需求不如預期。

ESG 圖表定義 
項目 定義 說明 
能源使用 
直接與間接能源消耗總量(十億焦耳) 
- 公司運營範圍內消耗之能源總量 
- 能源使用總量 = 直接能源消耗總量 + 間接能源消耗量 
- 總能源使用量包括購買的能源、生產的能源 
- 就公用事業而言，輸電/電網損耗為其業務活動之一部分，被視為總能源消耗，數據不包括
為滿足能源使用而生產的電力（公用事業為出售而生產） 
- 就公用事業而言，用於能源生產的煤、天然氣或核能等原料不屬於「總能源使用」項下

購買之再生能源 
Primary再生能源購買總量(十億焦耳) 
- 公司各種來源之能源消耗量與購買的能源中屬於自然界可再生者（太陽能、風能、水能、
生物質能、地熱能）之量  
- 如無證據顯示再生能源由公司生產，則所報告的能源數據視為購買的再生能源

再生能源使用率 再生能源占總能源消耗量之比例  
CO2 約當排放量 
直接 CO2 與 CO2 約當排放量(公噸) 
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量（範圍 1 排放量） 
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳 (CO2)、甲烷 (CH4)、一氧化二氮 (N2O)、氫氟碳化物 (HFCS)、全氟化
合物 (PFCS)、六氟化硫 (SF6)、三氟化氮 (NF3)

CO2 約當排放量營收比 
直接 CO2 與 CO2 約當排放量（公噸）銷售（百萬元）比 
- 公司擁有或控制的來源的直接排放量（範圍 1 排放量） 
- 相關氣體：二氧化碳 (CO2)、甲烷 (CH4)、一氧化二氮 (N2O)、氫氟碳化物 (HFCS)、全氟化
合物 (PFCS)、六氟化硫 (SF6)、三氟化氮 (NF3)

廢棄物總量 
廢棄物總量(公噸) 
- 總廢棄物 = 無害廢棄物 + 有害廢棄物 
- 僅考慮固體廢棄物，但如液體廢棄物以公噸為單位呈報，則會將其加入求得包含液體廢棄
物之總量 
- 對於採礦、石油與天然氣等行業，tailings、廢石、煤、飛灰等廢棄物亦考慮在內

廢棄物回收率 
公司呈報的廢棄物回收率 
- 廢棄物回收率 = 廢棄物回收量/總廢棄物*100 
- 廢棄物轉化為能源或經由廢棄物焚燒產生能源視為廢棄物回收 
- 經由堆肥回收的廢棄物視為回收之廢棄物

總取水量 
總取水量(立方公尺) 
- 由呈報組織直接或經水公司等中介機構從任何水源抽取的總水量 
- 水井、城鎮/公用事業/市政用水、河水、地表水等不同之水源均予以考慮

環保支出 
環保支出總金額 
- 所有用於環境保護，或防止、減少、控制環境因素、影響、危害的投資與支出，亦包括處
置、處理、衛生、清理支出

員工流動率 
員工流動率 
- 包括任何原因（自願或非自願）離開公司的員工，如辭職、退休、自然離職/死亡、醫療失
能、冗員、裁員、重組、解僱、裁減或定期合約到期 
- 員工流動率 =（離開之員工/平均員工人數）*100 
- 平均員工人數 =（本年末員工人數 + 去年末員工人數）/2 
- 本財年末員工數 =上個財年末員工數 + 新員工數 - 離開之員工數

女性經理 
女性經理百分比 
- 女性經理占公司經理的百分比 
- 如有不同階層之百分比，如最高階、高階、中階、初階，則會考慮中階女性經理之百分比 
- 女性經理百分比 = 女性經理人數/經理總數*100

女性員工 
女性員工百分比 
- 女性員工占公司員工總數的百分比 
- 女性員工百分比 = 女性人數/員工總數*100

教育訓練總時數 
所有員工教育訓練總時數 
- 僅考慮員工教育訓練時數 
- 包括一般員工所有類型的教育訓練（如健康與安全、環境、急難事件救援、技能與職業發
展） 
- 如果數據以天為單位，則乘以 8，係假設 1 天 =  8 小時工作

每位員工教育訓練時數 平均每年每位員工總教育訓練時數  
資料來源：Refinitiv；凱基

### Page 1

10 ⽉ 28 ⽇，微纳核芯宣布完成超 10 亿元 C2 轮融资，半年内累计融资 30 亿元。本轮融资估
值未披露，资⾦将主要⽤于产品开发迭代及供应链量产备货。微纳核芯第⼀代三颗芯⽚正
处于从投⽚向客⼾验证过渡的阶段。
摘要：
10 ⽉ 28 ⽇，杭州微纳核芯电⼦科技有限公司（以下简称：微纳核芯）宣布完成超 10 亿元 C2 轮融
资，由建投投资领投，杭州资本、凯泰资本、晓池资本、烟台财⾦、国投泰康等多家机构参
与，多名⽼股东继续加码。
微纳核芯称，加上 9 ⽉完成的 10 亿元 C1 轮融资，公司两个⽉内融资超过 20 亿元，半年内累计完
成 30 亿元融资。本轮融资估值未披露，资⾦将主要⽤于产品开发迭代及供应链量产备货。
融资持续推进之际，微纳核芯第⼀代三颗芯⽚正处于从投⽚向客⼾验证过渡的阶段。
微纳核芯成⽴于 2021 年，孵化于浙江省北⼤信息技术⾼等研究院，主要研发⾯向⼈⼯智能推理
的存算⼀体芯⽚。
传统计算架构需要在处理器与存储器之间频繁搬运数据，带来带宽和能耗开销。存算⼀体技术

尝试让部分计算在存储器内部或附近完成，以减少数据搬运。
微纳核芯采⽤⾃主研发的 3D-CIM 架构，融合 DRAM 三维近存计算、 SRAM 存算⼀体与 RISC-V 异
构计算，产品⾯向 AI ⼿机、 AI PC 等端侧设备，以及智算中⼼等云侧推理场景。
公司称， SRAM 存算⼀体架构在此前的流⽚测试中，相较传统冯 · 诺伊曼架构可提升 4 ⾄ 6 倍算⼒
密度、 5 ⾄ 10 倍能效⽐。公开材料未提供完整的对照芯⽚规格及测试条件。
产品进度⽅⾯，微纳核芯披露，第⼀代 LP-CIM 系列和 PCIe-CIM 系列共三颗芯⽚已全部投⽚，预
计 2027 年初正式进⾏客⼾送测并启动批量供货。
在此之前，公司已与多家⼿机平台、 ODM ⼚商及具⾝智能企业开展算法适配和⽅案开发，完成
多轮仿真器验证，部分项⽬进⼊深度联合调试阶段。云侧业务⽅⾯，公司与云服务商、 AI 基础设
施⼚商等推进算⼒⽅案评估及场景化 POC 测试。
这些⼯作为后续客⼾导⼊提供了基础，但仿真器验证、⽅案测试与实物芯⽚正式送测仍属于不

同环节。⽬前，公司尚未披露上述三颗芯⽚的具名送测客⼾、批量采购订单及收⼊规模。
微纳核芯所处的存算⼀体赛道，已有企业进⼊产品量产或规模出货阶段。
其中，后摩智能以 SRAM 存算⼀体技术布局相关产品， 10 ⽉中旬公开披露 M30 、 M50 芯⽚已实现
量产， M50 获得超过 150 个产品定点，⾸款 3D-CIM 芯⽚ A20 也已投产。知存科技则以 Flash 存内
计算技术切⼊低功耗终端市场，官⽹披露芯⽚累计出货量已超过千万颗。
云侧⽅向，亿铸科技基于 3D DRAM 技术研发存算⼀体芯⽚，相关产品已完成流⽚。 10 ⽉ 23 ⽇，
亿铸科技宣布完成超 10 亿元融资。
不同企业采⽤的存储介质、产品定位及商业化阶段并不完全相同。不过，从上述进展来看，存
算⼀体芯⽚的竞争已从架构设计和实验室性能指标，延伸⾄客⼾导⼊、量产交付与实际出货。

标普 500 指数收涨 0.3% ，纳斯达克 100 指数涨 0.5% 。芯⽚指数四连涨。盘后微软因云业务

摘要：
美联储如期暂停加息，但鹰派语调令市场解读困难；科技巨头财报业绩分化，盘后交易⼤幅波
动；与此同时，中东地缘⻛险持续扰动油价，拉美市场在巴西政治不确定性下继续承压。

0.27% ，道指涨 0.19% ，芯⽚指数涨 1.75% 、为连续第四个交易⽇收⾼。⼗⼀⼤板块⼋涨三跌，
科技涨 0.48% 、能源涨 0.41% 领跑，公⽤事业跌 0.88% 、房地产跌 0.65% 垫底。
美联储联邦公开市场委员会以 10 ⽐ 2 的投票结果，将联邦基⾦利率维持在 3.75% ⾄ 4% 的⽬标区

间，会后声明措辞温和，未对 12 ⽉政策路径给出明确信号。
美联储主席沃什在新闻发布会上强调不赞成前瞻指引，称 " 我不相信预判会议结果，很多事情都
可能发⽣ " ，同时对就业和经济前景持乐观态度，但指出通胀在超出⽬标⽔平近六年后仍是核⼼
压⼒。
期货市场维持对 12 ⽉加息的较⾼押注，但 2027 年的加息预期有所回落，市场不再完全消化本轮
周期三次以上加息的可能。

 上週美股市場概況：
上週美股在經濟數據將降溫中稱底下展現出顯著韌性，但盤面仍分化與估值壓力同步加劇。最新公布
的 9 月新增非農就業大幅走降至 2.9 萬人，同時失業率升至 4.2%，加上 8 月核心 PCE 溫和放緩與聯
準會官員偏鴿發言，使 10 月暫停加息的市場預期急升；然而，10 年期美債殖利率一度飆破 5.3% 創
年內高點、30 年期觸及 5.62% 的二十多年新高，疊加美伊局勢擾動油價與避險資金回流股市，持續
壓制大盤折現估值並使多數產業收跌，全週盤面全靠資訊科技上漲 1.4% 與費半 3.7% 在半導體、軟
體等相關科技類股帶動下勉強支撐，掩蓋了醫療、金融等八大板塊的廣泛疲弱，其中東芝擴產重創威

騰與希捷等 HDD 概念股逾 10%，拖累記憶體相關族群，以及零售端價格戰浮現，充分反映出當下
因基本面及利率壓力下的複雜度 ，市場廣度仍在低位 ，因此三大指數方面僅納斯達克綜合指數上漲
0.45% 至 27190.86，反觀標普 500 指數下跌 0.27% 至 7722.72；道瓊工業指數下跌 1.26% 至
51176.96。

 本週關注重點：
本週美股處於第三季財報季前的空檔期，市場緊盯長端利率定價，美國財政部預計於週三公布 20 至
30 年期國債回購操作規模此前單次上限為 60 億美元，上一次僅接受 40.8 億美元，並於週四、週五
接力進行 10 年期與 30 年期國債競拍。此外，聯準會、歐洲央行將於週四公布 9 月貨幣政策會議紀
要；經濟指標方面，週一 公布的美國 9 月 ISM 非製造業 PMI。

 9 月 FOMC 如預期升息一碼，儘管在消除不確定下，公債殖利率仍維持在高檔 。同時市場正在持續關注大型科技類股資本支出及其營收的效率 ，根據
Factset 資料預估 Q3 財報預估標普 500 每股盈餘年增為 27%，相比 Q2 的 33% 有所放緩，但 AI 基礎建設與雲端巨頭的強勁表現仍使科技股為大盤上漲
的主要動能，同時即將邁入多為上漲的第四季及期中選舉關鍵前夕，配合當下經濟數據仍具備穩健性質，可期待上漲行情仍能持續。然而，由於 10 月初

已顯漲幅集中於科技股，導致市場廣度的低迷，建議美股 Q3 財報前可部分獲利了結近期勁漲之半導體相關族群，以應對財報可能帶來的波動，等待分批
布局之機會，避開其餘利率敏感型族群。另外也同時部分握有基本面穩健之醫療保健類族群同步抗波動，消費族群因高通膨、利率近期相對承壓。
 歐洲各國的通膨進一步走高，然同步法國債信惡化下，近期升息步調可能暫緩，對於股市來說仍是中性看待；日本方面 8 月東京 CPI 也反彈至 1.9%，同
時電費與燃氣等補貼至 9 月已結束，10 月通膨數據將因價格調整下反彈，同步薪資通膨以及日圓貶勢未完全反轉下，通膨風險仍大，儘管 10 月升息預
期已轉為按兵不動，股市也同樣中性看待。整體而言日、歐股市在短線上須謹慎，需等待通膨與債市壓力等因子和緩後，長線仍看好。債券方面，目前公
司債信用利差走高有限，代表信用風險仍然可控，適合長期鎖利率布局投資等級公司債；採取中長天期搭配短天期的配置。總結以上，第一，慎選財報優
異族群，以科技為首，醫療為防禦配置；第二，日、歐因近期通膨壓力而轉為中性看待，長線看好；第三，布局投資等級債來進行長期鎖利配置。

 美國 9 月份新增非農就業人數僅為 2.9 萬人，低於市場所預期的 8.9 萬人，且 7 月與
8 月的就業數據合計大幅下修 6.0 萬人。失業率由 4.1% 微升至 4.2%，因新增 48.5
萬人進入勞動市場，亦推升勞動參與率 0.2 %至 61.8%，邊際勞工數量也由 146.8 萬
人創兩年新低，整體顯就業在放緩中又帶有勞動力的結構恢復。另外，平均每小時薪
資年增由 3.1% 放緩至 3.0%，持續降溫無礙核心物價，整體削弱 10 月升息預期。

 產業方面服務業仍是主要支撐 ，以教育和保健服務為首(+2萬)，休閒酒店(+1萬)、零
售(+5.8千人)、運輸倉儲(+7.6千人)等項目也仍在成長，但金融(-7千人)、科技(-1萬)
產業就業持續受AI衝擊而走降。另外由於政府部門近期波動較大 ，因此觀察官方非農
與小非農 ADP 新增就業人數的3個月移動平均，相較疫情前水準雖偏弱，但仍維持
不陷入衰退的格局，配合失業率仍處低檔，顯勞動市場依舊接近充分就業狀態。

 美國 8 月 PCE 物價年增持平於 3.4%，低於預期的 3.7%，同時核心物價年增也維持在 3.0%，低於預期的 3.3%，其中能源商品與服務年增達 16.8% 為

PCE 物價年增支撐的原因，然核心項目走降很大程度受益於 BEA 針對電腦軟體與配件、法律服務、投資組合管理服務三個細項統計方法的年度修正，這
次調整為核心通膨直接扣減了約 0.2 至 0.3 個百分點。總歸來看低於預期的數據發布後，市場對聯準會 10 月升息機率由逾５成降至約３成。然而在排
除能源影響下，物價仍保持一定僵固性，且 8 月 PCE 仍遠高於 2%，後續油價是通膨走降關鍵，並且留意核心項目的發展。
 細項方面，商品中的耐久財成長 0.1%，項目整體月增也沒有較前月明顯成長 ，僅由基期較低休閒娛樂品與 車輛年增反應較顯著；非耐久財月增由 -
0.4% 轉為 0.5%，年增由 3.3% 至 3.6%，由於 8 月國際油價再度上漲，非耐久財汽油及能源商品價格大漲 4.4%，年增也達到 27.9%；服務方面也由於
油價因素，交通運輸服務年增達 8 %，同時考慮到其餘服務相關物價指數項目，在 8 月多持平或走揚，因此觀察細項中排除非營利機構的服務家庭消費
支出月年增則上漲 0.1% 至 3.5%，顯示服務項目的僵固性仍存續。

 美國 8 月實質消費支出成長 0.55%，顯示消費動能依然強勁；然而實質

使第二季 GDP 終值上修至 2.2%，其中消費貢獻由 2.12pp 升至2.51pp
為最大宗，投資也有次要的貢獻，最終修正也達 0.82pp。
 此背景下，8 月強勁的消費表現可望為第三季 GDP 的支撐力量，延續成
長動能，然而當前儲蓄率過低則須留意 消費緩衝能力下降、以及後續消
費動能有限的問題。

 債市回顧：上週美國國債全線承壓收跌。雖有紐約聯儲主席 John Williams 與副主席 Phillip Jefferson 釋出「無需急於行動(升息)」的偏鴿發言，加上
8 月 PCE 及 9 月非農就業疲軟帶動市場對 10 月暫停升息的預期升溫，一度推動殖利率盤中回落，但 12 月升息機率反而走升。另外，在川普政府施壓
下 G7 同意釋放 1 億桶油儲以對沖油價波動，但由於通膨仍顯著高於 2.0% 目標，且同時歐債帶來的壓力也持續共振全球，10 年期法德利差在週五已至
2012 年以來最大，因此原油敘事使債市帶來的反彈仍被逆轉，財政擔憂與期限議價仍持續拉抬殖利率。整週來看，2 年期美債殖利率累計下跌 2 個基
點至 4.82%，10 年期美債殖利率則攀升 11 個基點至 5.27%，30 年期利率更一度觸及 5.62% 的 20 年以來新高。

(2026/10/2) (目前利率區間)

 短期展望：目前勞動市場穩健、通膨可控，經濟數據強勁下，市場普遍認為 12 月仍有一碼的空間，而非 10 月連續升息。而在此背景下，若油價無進
一步拉抬，本週 10 年期美債殖利率維持高檔震盪。而短端利率因升息預期逐步收斂未再顯著走升；相對地，長端的升幅較大，主要反映市場對更高長
期利率與期限溢酬的定價，但也非意味後續升息幅度必然更大。

歐洲專欄
 10 月 1 日法國總理勒科爾尼提出了 2027 年財政預算草案，計畫藉由約 430 億歐元的開支縮減與稅收調整，將預算赤字佔 GDP 比例從今年的近 5.5% 壓低

至 5.0%，以避免赤字恐飆破 6.5% 的失控局面。然而，即使該計畫順利落地，法國政府總債務占 GDP 比例仍將突破 120%，使官方宣稱在 2029 年將赤字
壓至 3% 的目標可能不切實際。另外，由於少數派政府在國民議會缺乏絕對多數，加上 2027 年春季總統大選將至、政壇極端勢力如極右翼國民聯盟（RN）
勒龐與極左翼不屈法國（LFI）梅朗雄民調持續高漲 (皆有望通過第一輪投票)，該預算極難在年底前獲得正常通過，恐迫使政府動用憲法手段強行過關並面臨
不信任案挑戰；在政治癱瘓與財政脆弱的雙重夾擊下，市場避險情緒驅使資金湧向德債，法德國公債利差短期可能突破 150 個基點。
 歐元區 9 月 HICP 初值年增率攀升 0.6 至 3.8%，創下三年新高且高於市場預期，反映中東局勢引發的能源價格衝擊；然而，法國財政動盪已促使市場金融條
件緊縮，歐洲央行預計本月不會急於升息，預計利率按兵不動，且在議會分裂與未承諾更積極財政調整的前提下，歐洲央行也難以直接啟動 TPI（傳導保護
工具）干預救市。儘管歐盟宣布釋放戰略柴油儲備暫時穩住了市場情緒，帶動歐元區公債與英國公債在尾盤回穩反彈，但仍無法扭轉短線上的基本面弱勢。

日本專欄 日央 9 月紀要偏鷹，短觀製造強服務弱，通膨預期緩和升息預期
 日本央行 9 月貨幣政策會議紀要顯示，多數委員認為需要持續升息以應對壓力，甚至有人主張加快步伐，整體顯鷹派態度。此次會議以 7 比 2 通過升
息，利率升至1995年以來最高，距離 6 月升息僅三個月，是自 1990 年以來最短間隔。背景是日本通膨環境出現改變，薪資增長、服務價格及進口成
本推動通膨接近2%，央行更關注能源價格、日圓走勢及企業定價行為。然而，央行內部也有意見認為應逐步升息，避免過於急迫，作為平衡考量。
 最新 9 月的短觀調查顯示全產業信心指數由 18 升至 21，主要受大型製造業帶動，該指數由 22 升至 24，創八年新高，反映全球 AI 需求強勁及供應

瓶頸緩解。相較之下，大型非製造業因原物料與人力成本上升 、消費者抗拒漲價，以及颱風豪雨衝擊餐飲旅宿業，指數微幅下滑至 35。另外大型產
業資本支出計畫年增率小幅下修 0.2 個百分點至 11.3%，但仍維持高檔，中小企業信心亦持續改善。企業對未來一年通膨預期下降至約 2.6%，三年
期則維持在 2.6%，顯示雖壓力仍高於央行目標，但未進一步升溫，降低了 10 月立即升息的急迫性，然而 12 月再度升息的可能性仍相對偏高。

 美光本季財報呈現標準且罕見的景氣完全爆發特徵
1. 遞延收入大幅上升：顯示客戶願意提前付款預定產能，營收能見度與保障度提高。
2. 營業活動現金流增速暴衝，且遠超營收與應收、應付增速：客戶預付款有效轉化
為實體營收，且收款能力增強。
3. 存貨中半成品與原料跳升，完成品庫存量持續下降：產品需求遠大於供給，完成
品無須存放便交與客戶。顯示市場供不應求情況加劇，公司產能滿載運轉。
4. 現金轉換循環驟降，且在遞延收入大增情況下，應收增速仍大於應付增速：銷貨
與產能周轉度極高，壓低存貨天數。且出貨量持續提升，放量迅速，客戶端待結
算金額迅速累積良性推升應收帳款增速。

營收(調整) 毛利率
 埃森哲業績、訂單增速皆超預期；大型數位、AI 轉型成為重要動能
埃森哲(ACN) 第四季業績全面超預期，營收年增 6% 至 186.8 億美元，超過市場預期 3.5% 也超出公司自身指引上緣。全年營收年增 5% 至 742 億美元；新訂單
年增 4% 至 220 億美元，超出市場預期約 11%，也相較前一年的年減 3% 明顯改善。2026 年累積訂單創紀錄達 845 億美元，並有 141 筆至少 1 億美元訂單。

此次財報緩解市場對「AI是否影響 IT 諮詢、軟體開發、外包服務需求」疑慮，執行長 Julie Sweet 表示大型企業如 FedEX 等正利用埃森哲來構建自身 AI 基礎設
施，反催生相關的新需求。
15

埃森哲預期 2027 全年自由現金流穩步成長，並未因 AI 影響而承壓
(十億美元)
埃森哲預期明年營收個位數增長，全年毛利率略升
 2027 年營收指引預計年增 3 ~ 6%，已考量不利因素；確立 AI 仍可創造新需求
2027 財年營收預計成長 3~ 6%，其中約 2% 為併購所提攜，而中東地區業務持續承壓，全年估計約影響 10 億美元營收，該因素已於指引中排除。併購 50 億
金額將明確聚焦高成長領域（如 AI、數據、數據中心、OT 安全等），以加速長期有機成長。公司表示指引基本面雖穩健但行業競爭激烈，業務規模雖成長但多
線業務價格小幅下滑。本次業績指引提升市場對 IT 諮詢產業的展望，證實 AI 促進各產業轉型，加速基礎設施建設可創造新市場需求。

足元の中国経済は、物価の二極化と外需依存が一段と鮮明に 
～企業部門のインフレと家計部門のディスインフレが共存、輸出好調による人民元高の行方は～ 
 経済調査部 主席エコノミスト  西濵 徹 
（℡：050-5474-7495）

（要旨） 
○ イラン情勢の悪化を受けた原油・天然ガス価格の上昇は、代替需要の拡大を通じて石炭価格
にも波及しており、中国もエネルギーインフレの影響を避けられなくなっている。９月の生
産者物価は調達価格が前年比＋6.9％、出荷価格が同＋5.0％とともに上昇が加速しており、
企業間取引においては価格転嫁の動きが広がっている。 一方、 消費者物価は前年比＋0.9％と
政府目標を下回り、 コアインフレ率も同＋1.0％と低水準で推移している。 雇用回復の遅れや
不動産不況の長期化を背景に家計の節約志向が根強く、最終消費財への価格転嫁は限定的で
ある。企業部門でインフレ圧力が強まる一方、家計部門ではディスインフレ圧力が残る二極
化が一段と鮮明になっている。 
○ 中国経済は内需が力強さを欠く一方、世界的なＡＩ・半導体需要の旺盛さなどを背景に外需
への依存を強めている。９月の輸出額は前年比＋36.3％、輸入額も同＋31.0％と伸びが加速
し、ともに単月ベースで過去最高を更新した。輸出は欧米やアジア新興国など幅広い地域向
けで拡大しており、関連する電子部品や鉱物資源の輸入も押し上げている。この結果、貿易
黒字は1335.3 億ドルに拡大しており、先行きの人民元相場を下支えすると期待される。 当局
も緩やかな人民元高を許容する姿勢をみせており、当面は堅調な相場推移が見込まれる。た
だし、過度な人民元高は輸出競争力の低下につながることから、今後は為替相場の安定に向
けた当局の対応に注意する必要がある。

【中国においては、企業部門のインフレと家計部門のディスインフレの共存が深刻化】 
イラン情勢を巡っては、 見通しが立たない状況が続いているうえ、 足元では混乱が中東全体に広
がりをみせている。イラン情勢の悪化をきっかけにした原油・天然ガスの価格上昇は、世界的なエ
ネルギーインフレを招いており、状況が一段と長期化する懸念が高まっている。中国は、一次エネ
ルギーに占める石炭比率がアジア新興国のなかでも高く、 原油・天然ガスの価格上昇による直接的
な影響は受けにくいと見込まれた。しかし、アジアを中心とする新興国では、原油・天然ガスから
石炭への代替需要が拡大し、価格が押し上げられている。さらに、世界最大の石炭輸出国であるイ
ンドネシアは、自国向け供給を優先して輸出規制を強化しており、価格が高止まりしている。その

結果、中国もエネルギーインフレの影響を避けられない状況に直面している。 
こうしたなか、川上段階の物価にあた
る９月の生産者物価（調達価格）は、前

ら加速して、2022 年６月以来の高い伸び
となった（図１）。前月比も＋1.2％と前
月 （同＋0.3％） から加速し、 上昇ペース
は４ヵ月ぶりの高い伸びとなるなど、物
価上昇圧力に直面している。原油・天然
ガスなどの価格上昇を反映してエネルギ
ー関連で物価上昇圧力が強まるととも
に、化学工業関連の原材料価格のほか、
商品市況の高止まりを受けて非鉄金属関連など幅広い分野で物価上昇の動きが確認されている。 こ
うした原材料価格の上昇を反映して、生産者物価（出荷価格）も前年同月比＋5.0％と前月（同＋
3.8％） から加速し、2022 年６月以来の高い伸びとなっている。前月比も＋1.2％と前月 （同＋0.4％）
から加速して５ヵ月ぶりの高い伸びとなり、 企業部門のあいだで原材料価格の上昇分を製品価格に
転嫁する動きが広がっている。 
さらに、エルニーニョ現象の発生を受けて、アジアでは異常気象が見込まれるなか、肥料価格の
高止まりも重なり、農業生産の低迷が食料インフレを招く懸念も高まっている。このため、家計部
門においては、食料品とエネルギーとい
う生活必需品を中心とするインフレ 懸
念が高まっている。こうした状況にもか
かわらず、９月の消費者物価は前年同月
比＋0.9％と前月（同＋0.8％）からわず
かに加速したものの、引き続き政府目標
（２％前後）を下回る伸びで推移してい
る （図２） 。 生鮮品を中心とする食料品価
格やエネルギー価格が上昇基調を強め
て い る に も か か わ ら ず 、 前 月 比 は ＋
0.2％と前月（同＋0.4％）から上昇ペー
スが鈍化している。食料品とエネルギーを除いたコアインフレ率は前年同月比＋1.0％となり、前
月 （同＋1.0％） から横ばいで推移している。 前月比も＋0.0％と前月 （同＋0.1％） から上昇ペース
が鈍化しており、家計部門の節約志向の高さを反映して、企業間取引では価格転嫁が進む一方、最
終消費財への転嫁は限定的であることが影響している。 さらに、 雇用回復の遅れを反映してサービ
ス物価は下落しており、 物価上昇圧力が高まりにくい状況にあるなど、 インフレとディスインフレ
が共存する展開が続いている。

【景気は外需依存を強める一方、緩やかな人民元高が続くと見込まれるが、当局の動きに注意】 
中国においては、企業部門においてインフレ圧力が強まる一方、雇用回復の遅れや不動産不況の
長期化を背景に、 家計部門が節約志向を強めていることを反映してディスインフレ圧力が根強く残
る。こうした状況を反映して、個人消費や不動産投資など内需は総じて力強さを欠いており、足元
の中国経済については、 成長を外需に依
存する傾向が強まっている。一方で、原
油・天然ガス価格の高止まりに加え、Ａ
Ｉ （人工知能） ・ 半導体関連の旺盛な需要
が世界経済を下支えするなか、 世界的に
金利が上昇している。その結果、米ドル
高圧力は根強く、 多くのアジア新興国通
貨に下押し圧力がかかる動きがみられ
る。一方後述のように、人民元の対ドル
相場は緩やかに上昇しており、 足元の通
貨バスケット（CFETS 人民元指数）は４
年ぶりの高値となるなど、輸出競争力の足かせとなることが懸念される（図３） 。 
こうした状況ではあるものの、９月の輸出額は前年同月比＋36.3％と前月（同＋25.0％）から加
速して、 ７ヵ月ぶりの高い伸びとなった。 当研究所が試算した季節調整値に基づく前月比も２ヵ月
連続で拡大しており、 単月ベースの輸出額は過去最高となるなど持ち直しの動きをみせている （図
４） 。 欧米諸国などは、 中国による貿易不
均衡の是正を求めて圧力を強めている
にもかかわらず、米国向け（前年比＋

ASEAN（東南アジア諸国連合） 向け （前年

4/4 
国製品全般に対する需要が堅調に推移していることも輸出を押し上げる展開が続いている。 
９月の輸入額も前年同月比＋31.0％と前月（同＋28.2％）から加速しており、４ヵ月ぶりの高い
伸びとなるなど輸出同様に堅調に推移している。 当研究所が試算した季節調整値に基づく前月比も
３ヵ月ぶりの拡大に転じており、 単月ベ
ースの輸入額も過去最高を更新し、 輸出
同様に持ち直しの動きをみせている（図
５）。前述のように、 ハイテク製品に対す
る需要が旺盛なことを反映して、 その生
産に必要なハイテク製品のほか、 半導体
をはじめとする電子部品関連の輸入額
は高い伸びで推移しており、 輸出が輸入
を押し上げる好循環がうかがえる。さら
に、 ハイテク製品の生産に必要な銅をは
じめとする鉱物資源の輸入も堅調に推
移しており、原材料や素材・部材の需要を活発化させている様子もうかがえる。一方で、内需が力
強さを欠いているなかで原油や天然ガス、 石炭などエネルギー資源の輸入量は軒並み前年を下回る
伸びとなっているものの、 価格が高止まりするなかで輸入額が押し上げられていることには注意が
必要である。 
この結果、９月の貿易収支は＋1335.3 億ドルと前月（＋1190.9 億ドル）から黒字幅が拡大して
おり、2025 年１月以来の高水準となった。巨額の貿易黒字は人民元に対する需要を下支えするとと
もに、 先行きの人民元相場の安定に寄与することが期待される。 さらに、 人民元の対ドル基準値 （中
間値） は連日４年半ぶりの人民元高水準で推移しており、 当局も緩やかな人民元高を許容する姿勢
をみせている。 先月に実施された米中首脳会談では、 米中双方が一部品目について相互に関税を引
き下げることで合意しており、先行きの対米輸出を下支えすることが期待される。このため、当面
の人民元相場は巨額の貿易黒字を背景に堅調な推移が続く可能性が高い。 一方、 人民元高が過度に
進行すれば輸出競争力の低下につながる可能性があるため、 当局が一方的な人民元高の動きを警戒
して、為替相場の安定に向けた対応を強める可能性には注意が必要である。
